nodes.name: Institutional Financial Svcs

nodes.name: Insurance

nodes.definition: This industry includes companies that own or develop real estate assets. Such companies derive rental income or sell real estate for asset appreciation and are not structured as real estate investment trusts (REITs).

nodes.name: REIT
nodes.definition: This industry includes companies that own or develop real estate assets and are structured as a real estate investment trusts (REITs). Companies with other similar structures that provide a tax benefit and have a defined distribution policy are also included. Excludes REITs which primarily invest in real estate loans (see Mortgage REIT).

nodes.name: Real Estate Services
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that provide specialized services for real estate. Includes property and/or third-party asset management, brokerage, and information services for real estate owners.

nodes.name: Biotech & Pharma

nodes.name: Health Care Facilities & Svcs
nodes.definition: This industry includes companies that provide health care services. These services may be standalone or offered as part of operating a specialized facility.

nodes.name: Medical Equipment & Devices
nodes.definition: This industry includes companies that manufacture health care products for medical treatments and diagnostics.

nodes.name: Diversified Industrials
nodes.definition: This industry includes companies that manufacture various industrial products. Typically, these companies are large conglomerates that are diversified across multiple industries within the Industrials sector.

nodes.name: Aerospace & Defense
nodes.definition: This industry includes companies that manufacture aerospace and defense products.

nodes.name: Electrical Equipment
nodes.definition: This industry includes companies that manufacture electric powered equipment used in industrial applications other than manufacturing. Includes equipment installed in buildings and equipment used in the electricity grid.

nodes.name: Machinery

nodes.name: Transportation Equipment

nodes.name: Industrial Support Services

nodes.name: Commercial Support Services

nodes.name: Transportation & Logistics
nodes.definition: This industry includes companies that provide freight transportation and related logistic services. Includes air freight, railroad, trucking and marine shipping services, logistics services, and postal and courier delivery services.

nodes.name: Engineering & Construction

nodes.name: Chemicals

nodes.name: Construction Materials

nodes.name: Containers & Packaging

nodes.name: Forestry, Paper & Wood Products
nodes.definition: This industry includes companies that conduct forestry operations or manufacture paper products. Excludes paper products (see Containers & Packaging).

nodes.name: Steel
nodes.definition: This industry includes companies that operate throughout the steel manufacturing supply chain.

nodes.name: Metals & Mining
nodes.definition: This industry includes companies that mine metals and minerals. Includes stone mining and quarrying, non-ferrous metals smelting and manufacturing, and mining support services.

nodes.name: Technology Hardware
nodes.definition: This industry includes companies that design or manufacture technology hardware products.

nodes.name: Semiconductors
nodes.definition: This industry includes companies that manufacture semiconductor integrated circuits (ICs) or its capital equipment.

nodes.name: Software

nodes.name: IT Services
nodes.definition: This industry includes companies that provide services primarily using technology-related skills, software, and technology hardware.

nodes.name: Electric Utilities

nodes.name: Gas & Water Utilities

nodes.name: Elec & Gas Marketing & Trading

nodes.name: Sovereign Government
nodes.definition: This industry includes entities that have the highest authority over a defined territory. These are independent governments that can levy taxes, issue debt, and create laws.

nodes.name: Sovereign Agencies
nodes.definition: This industry includes entities that provide administration and oversight of specific governmental functions on behalf of sovereign governments. These activities include regulation, law enforcement, tax collection and distribution, social and economic services, international diplomacy, and other country-level support services. Excludes entities in the private sector providing services elsewhere classifiable, such as utilities, rail transportation, or hospitals.

nodes.name: Governmental Banks
nodes.definition: This industry includes entities that provide specialized financing and financial services to promote a specific country's economic development or monetary stability. Typically, these entities are structured as banks and may diversify into private sector banking activities.

nodes.name: Regional
nodes.definition: This industry includes entities that perform governmental activities and services for a regional subdivision of a country, such as a state or province.

nodes.name: Local
nodes.definition: This industry includes entities that perform governmental activities and services within the smallest administrative division of a country.

nodes.name: Film & TV

nodes.name: Music

nodes.name: Video Games

nodes.name: Publishing

nodes.name: Local TV & Radio Broadcast
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that provide television and radio broadcasting typically via public airwaves

nodes.name: Out-of-Home Display Advertising
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that own and operate public display advertising, such as billboards, shopping mall and retail displays, bus advertisements, and other public displays.

nodes.name: Internet Media & Services
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes websites that create and distribute content, or provide services online.

nodes.name: Wireless Telecommunications
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that use a wireless infrastructure to provide a variety of services, such as wireless telephony services, wireless data services, text messaging/short messaging services (SMS), roaming, wireless Internet services, and satellite telecommunications. These companies have spectrum licenses and provide services using that spectrum.

nodes.name: Wireline Telecommunications
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that operate facilities and infrastructure that supplies voice, data, text, and sound using wired switching and transmission networks.

nodes.name: Apparel, Footwear & Acc Design
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that design and manufacturer apparel, footwear, and accessories. Excludes designers who own and operate their own retail store and the majority of their revenue comes from retail operations (see Specialty Apparel Stores).

nodes.name: Textile & Textile Products
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that produce textiles, such as yarns, threads, fabrics, and leather.

nodes.name: Automobiles
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture automobiles (passenger cars), light trucks, motorcycles and sport utility vehicles. Excludes passenger vehicles manufactured for commercial use, medium duty trucks and heavy duty trucks.

nodes.name: Auto Parts
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture various types of automotive parts. Excludes companies that manufacture parts for commercial vehicles (see Commercial Vehicles) and motorcycles (see Motorcycles).

nodes.name: Homebuilding
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that build and sell single family homes, townhouses, and other similar residential homes. Excludes companies that rent properties.

nodes.name: Building Products
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture building products, appliances, tools, and lawn and garden supplies. Excludes all raw materials classified under Materials.

nodes.name: Household Appliances
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture electric housewares, fans, vacuum cleaners, cooking appliances, and major household appliances including refrigerators, freezers, and laundry equipment.

nodes.name: Furniture
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture household furniture, office furniture, institutional furniture, mattresses, shades, and blinds.

nodes.name: Housewares
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture small, durable household goods not elsewhere classifiable.

nodes.name: Office Supplies
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture office supplies such as envelopes, notebooks, writing instruments, folders, and carbon paper.

nodes.name: Toys & Games
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture physical products used for leisure such as dolls, toys, board games, playing cards, puzzles, hobby items, and crafts. Excludes video game consoles (see Video Game Equipment), and their games (see Video Game Software).

nodes.name: Music Instruments
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture stringed, keyboard, woodwind, brass, and percussion instruments used to perform music.

nodes.name: Recreational Vehicles
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture motor homes, travel trailers, campers, and recreational vehicle equipment.

nodes.name: Sporting Goods
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture sporting equipment.

nodes.name: Consumer Goods Rental
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that rent consumer goods, such as appliances, formal wear, costumes, fitness equipment, and power tools.

nodes.name: Educational Services
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that provide instruction and training for a variety of social, business, and language sciences and subjects. Instruction and training may be facilitated on a full-time, part-time, distance learning, or occasional basis through institutions such as schools, colleges, universities, and professional institutes.

nodes.name: Funeral Services
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that provide services for burial or cremation of human or animal remains. Includes mortician services, burial plots, tombs, gravestones, and casket manufacturers.

nodes.name: Non-Profit Organization
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes organizations that provide consumer services on a non-profit basis not elsewhere classifiable, including charitable, humanitarian, or religious services, and advocate organizations.

nodes.name: Personal Care Services
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that provide services for personal wellness, including beauty salons and weight management services. This industry does not include fitness centers (see Fitness & Recreation Centers).

nodes.name: Photography Services
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that offer photography and videography services. Includes developing and printing services that utilize the photo in a retail product like picture books, cards, and coffee mugs.

nodes.name: Political Committees
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes entities that collect and spend money in elections, or on political issues. These committees may be set up for candidates, corporations, trade associations, or by private citizens wishing to make independent expenditures.

nodes.name: Residential Contractors
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that build additions or make alterations, renovations, or any other home improvements to residential buildings.

nodes.name: Other Consumer Services
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that provide laundry services, consumer goods repair services, remodeling services, and consumer services not elsewhere classified.

nodes.name: Casinos & Gaming
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that provide casino gaming without lodging. Also includes online gaming, racetracks, gaming equipment manufacturers and lottery services.

nodes.name: Cruise Lines
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that provide transportation and leisure entertainment, such as deep sea cruises and river cruises.

nodes.name: Lodging
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that provide temporary accommodation and usually charge a daily rate for their use.

nodes.name: Restaurants
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that prepare, serve, or provide food for immediate consumption. The facilities can be seated, takeout, mobile vehicles, or carts.

nodes.name: Entertainment Facilities
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that operate various types of entertainment and recreational facilities.

nodes.name: Travel Services
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that provide travel arrangement and/or tour operating services.

nodes.name: Apparel & Footwear Whslrs
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that wholesale and distribute fashion apparel, sports clothing, outerwear, and footwear.

nodes.name: Automotive Wholesalers
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that wholesale and distribute motor vehicles and parts. Excludes companies that manufacture motor vehicles or their parts.

nodes.name: Consumer Elec & Applc Whslrs
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that wholesale and distribute household consumer electronics and appliances. Includes consumer electronics, household appliances, photography equipment, computers and software.

nodes.name: Home & Office Product Whslrs
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that wholesale and distribute home or office furniture, home furnishings, office equipment, hardware, paint, wallpaper, and personal or office stationery.

nodes.name: Other Wholesalers
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that wholesale and distribute products not elsewhere classified.

nodes.name: Import & Export
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that wholesale international trade merchandise using their own money or on behalf of someone else for a fee.

nodes.name: Automotive Retailers
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes stores that specialize in retailing automotive parts and products. Such companies may also provide related repair or rental services.

nodes.name: Catalog & TV Based Retailers
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that retail merchandise through mail catalogs or television.

nodes.name: Electronics & Appliances Stores
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes stores that specialize in retailing consumer electronics, appliances, and other technology focused products.

nodes.name: Department Stores
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes retail stores with separate departments for various merchandise lines, such as apparel, jewelry, home furnishings, and linens, each with separate cash registers and sales associates.

nodes.name: Home Products Stores
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes stores that specialize in retailing products involved in building, improving, furnishing, or decorating homes.

nodes.name: Jewelry & Watch Stores
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes stores that specialize in retailing jewelry, watches, precious stones, and precious metal goods.

nodes.name: Specialty Apparel Stores
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes stores that specialize in retailing apparel, footwear and accessories.

nodes.name: Sporting Goods Stores
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes stores that specialize in retailing sporting goods, outdoor recreational products, and small arms.

nodes.name: Specialty Online Retailers
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that specialize in retailing specific merchandise lines on the Internet.

nodes.name: Agricultural Producers
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that grow, raise or produce raw crop or animal ingredient for consumption. Typically, these companies do not market or package their products for retail sales but are suppliers to food manufacturing companies and other commercial customers. Excludes crops not utilized for food consumption purposes, such as ornamental plants, tobacco, cotton or rubber trees.

nodes.name: Packaged Food
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that process and package finished food products. Typically, these products are marketed for retail consumers, carry a brand name, and can be found on food retailer's shelves. Also includes packaged pet foods.

nodes.name: Alcoholic Beverages
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that brew beer, manufacture wine and brandies, and distill and mix liquors.

nodes.name: Non-Alcoholic Beverages
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture non-alcoholic beverages.

nodes.name: Tobacco
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that process tobacco leaf and/or produce finished tobacco products.

nodes.name: Cannabis
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies involved in growing, manufacturing, wholesaling, or retailing cannabis products used for recreational or medicinal purposes. Excludes companies indirectly involved in the supply chain such as consultants or equipment manufacturers.

nodes.name: Home Products
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture products that consumers typically need to maintain or operate their house.

nodes.name: Personal Care Products
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture personal hygiene products.

nodes.name: Consumer Healthcare Products
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture and market consumer products that address a therapeutic need but do not require a prescription.  Some common products include botanical-based medicine, nutraceuticals, over-the-counter (OTC) drugs, vitamins and dietary supplements.

nodes.name: Agricultural Products Whslrs
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that wholesale and distribute agricultural supplies, such as grains, beans, livestock, and other farm supplies. Excludes companies that wholesale agricultural machinery and equipment (see Farm/Garden Mach/Equip Whslrs).

nodes.name: Food & Beverage Wholesalers
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that wholesale and distribute food and beverages.

nodes.name: Other Wholesalers - Staples
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that wholesale and distribute consumer staples not elsewhere classified.

nodes.name: Food & Drug Stores
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes stores that specialize in retailing food, beverages, or pharmaceuticals.

nodes.name: Mass Merchants
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes retail stores that carry a broad range of merchandise.

nodes.name: Integrated Oils
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes large companies that are vertically integrated into exploration, production, and refining.

nodes.name: Exploration & Production
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that explore for, extract, or produce crude oil and natural gas products.

nodes.name: Midstream - Oil & Gas
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that own and operate infrastructure used to transport oil, oil products, and natural gas. These companies may realize revenue through toll transportation and storage services or through purchasing and reselling the underlying products after transportation.

nodes.name: Refining & Marketing
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that process crude petroleum into refined petroleum products, such as gasoline and kerosene. Also includes companies that market these refined petroleum products to downstream users.

nodes.name: Drilling & Drilling Support
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that provide contract drilling services or provide support services for drilling operations and drilling platforms.

nodes.name: Oilfield Services & Equipment
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that provide services or manufacture equipment for non-drilling applications. Includes services such as well servicing and maintenance, fluid handling, snubbing, coiled-tubing, pressure pumping, wire-line, artificial lift, and production testing. Also includes suppliers or manufacturers of subsea, completion, and surface equipment and hydraulic fracturing proppants.

nodes.name: Biofuels
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that produce fuel by using renewable resources rather than fossil fuels.

nodes.name: Renewable Energy Equipment
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture equipment used to capture or store power from renewable energy sources.

nodes.name: Renewable Energy Project Dev
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that develop, build, and manage renewable energy projects. Includes companies that provide operations and maintenance services.

nodes.name: Diversified Banks
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that have multinational bank operations with significant institutional brokerage operations.

nodes.name: Banks
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that accept deposits and make loans.

nodes.name: Investment Companies
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manage and invest a company-owned portfolio for their own direct gain.

nodes.name: Investment Management
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that provide traditional investment management services for individual and institutional investors.

nodes.name: Private Equity
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes investment firms investing in private companies. Such firms engage in leveraged buyout (LBO) transactions, private placements of securities, and ownership of private companies for investment purposes.

nodes.name: Wealth Management
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that specialize in managing the wealth of affluent and high-net-worth individuals. Typically, these companies behave as a one-stop shop and offer other related financial services for the convenience of their clients.

nodes.name: Commercial Finance
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that provide loans, factoring, and other financing to businesses. Includes the leasing of commercial, industrial, and transportation equipment.

nodes.name: Consumer Finance
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that provide loans to consumers, including auto loans, consumer microlending, credit and debit, and student loans.

nodes.name: Mortgage Finance
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that provide mortgage financing services. Includes mortgage lenders, mortgage bankers, mortgage real estate investment trusts (REITs), mortgage loan brokers, mortgage insurers, and title insurers.

nodes.name: Other Financial Services
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that provide other types of financial services not elsewhere classified.

nodes.name: Institutional Brokerage
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that provide brokerage services to institutional investors. These companies buy or sell securities on behalf of organizations, such as banks, insurance companies, hedge funds, pension funds, and mutual funds. Includes companies that provide financial advice and/or underwriting for corporations and governments.

nodes.name: Instl Trust, Fiduciary & Custody
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that are authorized to hold assets in trust and provide services for registering securities and transferring ownership.

nodes.name: Security & Cmdty Exchanges
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes firms that operate a marketplace for the buying and selling of securities, commodities, or other financial instruments.

nodes.name: Life Insurance
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that directly underwrite life insurance policies, such as life, accidental death, disability, and annuities.

nodes.name: P&C Insurance
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that directly underwrite property and casualty insurance policies, such as automobile, property damage, casualty, theft, fire, malpractice, marine, workers' compensation, and homeowners insurance.

nodes.name: Islamic Insurance
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that underwrite direct or indirect insurance products in compliance with Islamic law such as Takaful. Includes health and life insurance.

nodes.name: Reinsurance
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that underwrite reinsurance for life, health and medical, property and casualty, title, and other insurance policies.

nodes.name: Insurance Brokers & Services
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that act as insurance intermediaries to sell insurance policies and other insurance-related products like annuities.

nodes.name: Health Insurance
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that directly underwrite health insurance policies such as supplemental health insurance. Excludes health insurance provided via a health maintenance organization (HMO).

nodes.name: Multi Asset Class Own & Develop
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes non-REIT owners and developers of multiple property types.
nodes.nameZh: 多种资产类别业主与开发商

nodes.name: Health Care Owners & Develop
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes non-REIT owners and developers of health care properties.
nodes.nameZh: 医疗保健物业业主与开发商

nodes.name: Hotel Owners & Developers
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes non-REIT owners and developers of hotel/lodging properties.

nodes.name: Residential Owners & Developers
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes non-REIT owners and developers of residential housing facilities.

nodes.name: Industrial Owners & Developers
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes non-REIT owners and developers of industrial properties, such as warehouse, distribution, temperature-controlled logistics, and flex space.

nodes.name: Office Owners & Developers
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes non-REIT owners and developers of office buildings.

nodes.name: Retail Owners & Developers
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes non-REIT owners and developers of retail real estate, such as outlet spaces, strip centers, shopping malls, and single-tenant entities.
nodes.nameZh: 零售地产业主与开发商

nodes.name: Self-Storage Owners & Develop
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes non-REIT owners and developers of self-storage units/properties.
nodes.nameZh: 自助仓库业主与开发商

nodes.name: Specialty Owners & Developers
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes non-REIT owners and developers of specialty and other properties not elsewhere classified.

nodes.name: Multi Asset Class REIT
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes real estate investment trusts (REITs) that own and develop multiple types of property.

nodes.name: Health Care REIT
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes real estate investment trusts (REITs) that own and develop health care properties.

nodes.name: Hotel REIT
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes real estate investment trusts (REITs) that own and develop hotel/resort properties.

nodes.name: Residential REIT
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes real estate investment trusts (REITs) that own and develop residential housing facilities.

nodes.name: Industrial REIT
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes real estate investment trusts (REITs) that own and develop industrial properties, such as warehouses, distribution centers, flex spaces, and industrial parks.

nodes.name: Office REIT
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes real estate investment trusts (REITs) that own and develop office buildings in either central business districts or the suburbs.

nodes.name: Retail REIT
nodes.definition: This segment includes real estate investment trusts (REITs) that own and develop retail real estate, such as outlet spaces, strip centers, malls, and single-tenant entities.

nodes.name: Self-storage REIT
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes real estate investment trusts (REITs) that own and develop self-storage units and facilities.

nodes.name: Timber REIT
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes real estate investment trusts (REITs) that own and develop tracts of timberlands.

nodes.name: Data Center REIT
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes real estate investment trusts (REITs) that own and develop data centers.

nodes.name: Infrastructure REIT
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes real estate investment trusts (REITs) that own and develop infrastructure assets for the communications, energy, transportation, and/or utility industries.

nodes.name: Gaming REIT
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes real estate investment trusts (REITs) that own and develop gaming related properties such as casinos, betting shops, racetracks, and casino hotels.

nodes.name: Specialty REIT
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes real estate investment trusts (REITs) that own and develop specialty and other properties not elsewhere classified.

nodes.name: Real Estate Services
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that provide specialized services for real estate. Includes property and/or third-party asset management, brokerage, and information services for real estate owners.

nodes.name: Large Pharma
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes large companies that are involved in all stages of the pharmaceutical industry from drug discovery to manufacturing and marketing.

nodes.name: Biotech
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that specialize in discovering, developing, and patenting novel pharmaceuticals for high-value/high-risk frontier pharmaceutical targets, including immunology and oncology.

nodes.name: Specialty & Generic Pharma
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that specialize in the manufacturing and marketing of pharmaceuticals.

nodes.name: Health Care Facilities
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes health care facilities that provide general medical treatment and surgery, psychiatric and substance abuse treatment, nursing homes, and specialty services to patients with a variety of medical conditions.

nodes.name: Health Care Services
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that provide standalone health care services or ancillary related health care services.

nodes.name: Health Care Supply Chain
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that provide distribution channels for health care products.

nodes.name: Managed Care
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that provide managed health care services through a health maintenance organization (HMO).

nodes.name: Health Care Supplies
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture surgical appliances, supplies, and ophthalmic goods, such as eyeglasses and contacts lenses.

nodes.name: Life Science & Diagnostics
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture in-vitro (not internal) diagnostic substances for use in diagnostic tests and companies that manufacture analytical laboratory instruments.

nodes.name: Medical Devices
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that design and manufacture medical devices which are implanted within the human body.

nodes.name: Medical Equipment
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture health care equipment. Includes equipment for cosmetic surgery, radiation therapy and imaging, medication monitoring and delivery, telemetry monitoring, and dentistry.

nodes.name: Diversified Industrials
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture various industrial products. Typically, these companies are large conglomerates that are diversified across multiple industries within the Industrials sector.

nodes.name: Aircraft & Parts
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture commercial aircrafts and their parts. Excludes aircrafts and parts used for military purposes (See Military Aircraft).

nodes.name: Defense
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture parts, supplies, and equipment for military applications.

nodes.name: Comml & Res Bldg Equip & Sys
nodes.nameLong: Commercial & Residential Building Equipment & Systems Manufacturing
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture non-structural commercial and residential building equipment, such as HVAC systems, elevators, and security devices.
nodes.nameZh: 商业与住宅建筑设备与系统

nodes.name: Electrical Power Equipment
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture equipment used in the generation and distribution of electricity.

nodes.name: Industrial Automation Controls
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture systems and devices used to automate, monitor, and optimize various processes such as controllers, sensors, switches, and software.

nodes.name: Measurement Instruments
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that design or manufacture devices used to test, measure, and analyze processes and environmental conditions.

nodes.name: Electrical Components
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture electrical components used for electrical equipment. Includes coils, electrical motors, wires, and cables. Excludes electrical components used for technology hardware (see Electronics Component).

nodes.name: Agricultural Machinery
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture agricultural machinery parts, farm machinery and equipment, and home lawn and garden equipment.

nodes.name: Construction & Mining Machinery
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture construction and mining machinery and parts. Products include earthmoving equipment, rubber tracked loaders, compact equipment, paving machinery, and cranes.

nodes.name: Engine & Transmission
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture mechanical power equipment, transmission shafts, cranks, camshafts, crankshafts, gears, gearboxes, couplings, and fully assembled internal combustion engines.

nodes.name: Factory Automation Equipment
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture equipment used in manufacturing facilities. Such equipment includes robots, linear actuation devices, automated production equipment, assembly machinery, automated welding machines, and sorters.

nodes.name: Flow Control Equipment
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture equipment used in hydraulic, as well as fluid, gas and liquid, handling equipment such as control valves, pressure regulators, and pneumatic electronic instrumentation.

nodes.name: Other Machinery & Equipment
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture industrial machinery not elsewhere classified.

nodes.name: Material Handling Machinery
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture equipment involved in movement, storage and control of products in the manufacturing and distribution of goods. Includes lift trucks, storage and handling equipment, and conveyor systems.

nodes.name: Metalworking Machinery
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture machinery used to mechanically transform metal by casting, forming, cutting, and joining.

nodes.name: Pollution Control Equipment
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture pollution control equipment. Includes air and water purification equipment, air and liquid filtration equipment, and filters.

nodes.name: Commercial Vehicles
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture on-highway commercial vehicles, trailers, engines, and parts, including tire retreading.

nodes.name: Railroad Rolling Stock
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture locomotives, transit passenger service cars, freight cars, railroads, and rail equipment parts.

nodes.name: Shipbuilding
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture ships and boats for commercial use, such as bulk carriers, container ships, cruise ships, ferries, and oil tankers. Excludes yachts and recreational boats (see Recreational Vehicles).

nodes.name: Fabricated Metal & Hardware
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture semi-finished metal products. These companies typically specialize in a specific type of metalworking manufacturing process or a specific type of metal product.

nodes.name: Rubber & Plastic
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture rubber and plastic products. Includes laminated plastics, polystyrene foam, plastic film, and rubber products used in mechanical product manufacturing, such as gasket and absorption parts.

nodes.name: Industrial Wholesale & Rental
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that wholesale-distribute or rent any type of machinery, equipment, or supplies for industrial use.

nodes.name: Industrial Maintenance Svcs
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that provide maintenance and repair services for industrial machinery, equipment, and facilities.

nodes.name: Building Maintenance Services
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that provide services to assist in a facility's day-to-day functions. Such services include basic building repairs, painting, janitorial services, landscape maintenance, and pest control.

nodes.name: Food Services
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that provide catering for a single event or long-term food services for a specified period of time via contract. They may cater single events at different locations or continually operate concessions at sports or similar facilities. The food may be served or offered cafeteria style.

nodes.name: Printing Services
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that provide a variety of copying, document preparation, and support services for printing activities.

nodes.name: Security Services
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that provide security services including guard/patrol services, armored car transportation, bodyguards, polygraph testing, security system operation, and fingerprinting services.

nodes.name: Other Commercial Support Svcs
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that provide commercial services not elsewhere classified.

nodes.name: Waste Management
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that collect, store, dispose, recycle, or treat various forms of waste. Includes organic and hazardous waste materials, landfills, incineration, and treatment plants.

nodes.name: Professional Services
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that provide advice and services based on specialized knowledge, training, education, or licensing in fields such as law, lobbying, employment, or accounting.

nodes.name: Airlines
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that provide air transportation services, such as air freight and air commuter carriers.

nodes.name: Air Freight
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that provide air freight transportation services, including shipping freight or mail on passenger airlines or dedicated air freight cargo planes.

nodes.name: Courier Services
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that provide courier delivery services. Such services include pickup and delivery of letters, small packages, and documents. Delivery services can be done by air or ground transportation.

nodes.name: Marine Shipping
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that provide marine transportation services, including freight transportation and oil tankers.

nodes.name: Rail Freight
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that provide railroad freight transportation services. Such services are provided over a long distance within a rail network. This does not include rail passenger transportation (see Transit Services).

nodes.name: Trucking
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that provide trucking services. Includes truckload freight, less-than-truckload freight delivery services, and specialized freight trucking services.

nodes.name: Transit Services
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that operate forms of passenger transportation services not elsewhere classified. Includes taxis, ferries, helicopters and other novelty forms of transportation such as limos, rickshaws, and horse carriages.

nodes.name: Logistics Services
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that provide asset light trucking, transportation brokerage, intermodal, freight forwarding, and logistic services.

nodes.name: Transport Operations & Services
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that support transportation by operating infrastructure or directly providing support services.

nodes.name: Engineering Services
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that provide engineering services, such as design, development, and feasibility study services, but do not actually execute the project.

nodes.name: Infrastructure Construction
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that construct structures, or fixed networks primarily for communications, energy, transportation, or utility purposes.

nodes.name: Building Construction
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that construct buildings. Typically, these buildings are large, multi-storied, composed of steel or concrete, and are for commercial or industrial use.

nodes.name: Agricultural Chemicals
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture chemicals used in agricultural operations.

nodes.name: Basic & Diversified Chemicals
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture basic component chemicals or intermediates in high volumes. These companies typically produce commodity chemicals.

nodes.name: Specialty Chemicals
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture chemicals for specific applications, and sometimes for specific customers. These chemicals are frequently manufactured in smaller volumes and at higher price points.

nodes.name: Chemicals Distribution
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that wholesale and distribute chemicals. Excludes companies that manufacture chemicals or wholesale and distribute chemicals for agricultural purposes (see Agricultural Chemicals Retailing & Distribution).

nodes.name: Cement & Aggregates
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture cement and aggregates.

nodes.name: Building Materials
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture non-wood products and materials used in construction.

nodes.name: Containers & Packaging
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture containers and packaging materials.

nodes.name: Forestry & Logging
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies involved in the growth, management and harvest of timber or rubber trees in natural or planted forests. This industry also includes nursery and tree products.

nodes.name: Paper & Pulp Mills
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture raw pulp materials and bulk paper for printing.

nodes.name: Wood Products
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture wood products and wood materials primarily used in construction. Excludes wood products used in interior furnishings (see Home Improvement).

nodes.name: Steel Producers
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that produce steel and steel products. Typically, these companies are vertically integrated and operate their own iron and steel mills.

nodes.name: Metal Svc Centers & Processors
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that process, store, and distribute steel materials for end use in various industries.
nodes.nameZh: 金属服务中心与加工商

nodes.name: Iron
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that mine, refine, and cast iron.

nodes.name: Base Metals
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that mine base metals and their aggregates, such as aluminum, copper, lead, zinc, and nickel.

nodes.name: Precious Metals
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that mine precious metals and their aggregates.

nodes.name: Mineral & Precious Stone Mining
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that mine minerals and precious stones. Excludes non-precious stones (see Stone Building Products).

nodes.name: Coal Mining
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that mine coal.

nodes.name: Mining Services
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that provide support services for coal and metal mining.

nodes.name: Metals & Ore Whslrs & Traders
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that trade minerals and/or metals.
nodes.nameZh: 金属与矿石批发商及贸易商

nodes.name: Communications Equipment
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture technology hardware used for communication purposes. Includes broadcasting equipment, networking equipment, mobile phones, and telecommunication equipment.

nodes.name: Consumer Electronics
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that design or manufacture consumer electronics. Includes audio equipment, cameras, video equipment, televisions, monitors, video game consoles, and GPS devices. Excludes electronics used for communication purposes (see Communication Equipment). Excludes hardware used in offices (see Office Electronics).

nodes.name: Computer Hardware & Storage
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that design or manufacture computer systems or data storage devices. Computer systems include desktops, laptops, tablets, workstations, servers, and supercomputers. Storage devices include hard disk drives, solid disk drives, and other storage devices.

nodes.name: Specialty Technology Hardware
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that design, or manufacture specialty hardware not elsewhere classified. Includes biometrics, traffic management systems, embedded computing hardware, and other miscellaneous hardware.

nodes.name: Electronics Components
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that design or manufacture components used within technology hardware. Typically, these components are non-finished goods or semi-finished goods. Exclude components used for industrial products (see Electrical Components).

nodes.name: EMS/ODM
nodes.nameLong: Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) or Original Design Manufacturing (ODM)
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that provide electronics manufacturing services (EMS) or original design manufacturing (ODM) services. These companies are contract manufacturers that provide outsource manufacturing services for hardware companies. They may also manufacture their own brand-name products.

nodes.name: Technology Distributors
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies who specialize in distributing hardware, electronics components, software, and services utilized for technology products. Typically, these companies act as suppliers to technology hardware manufacturers (OEM/EMS/ODM) sourcing components and parts that will be integrated into their final products.

nodes.name: Semiconductor Mfg
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that manufacture semiconductors. Includes companies that supply capital equipment and materials and outsourced manufacturing services. Excludes companies that design the semiconductor devices themselves (see Semiconductor Devices).

nodes.name: Semiconductor Devices
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that design or manufacture semiconductor devices or integrated circuits (ICs). Excludes outsourced semiconductor manufacturing services for semiconductor design companies (see Foundries).

nodes.name: Application Software
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that develop application software. Typically, application software is designed to assist or perform a specific activity and requires infrastructure software to operate.

nodes.name: Infrastructure Software
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that develop software that controls the basic operations and management of computing resources. Also includes cloud and virtualization services.

nodes.name: IT Services
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that provide information technology services for commercial organizations and government agencies.

nodes.name: Integrated Electric Utilities
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that operate across the regulated electricity value chains from electricity generation to transmission/distribution networks.

nodes.name: Power Generation
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that generate electricity from centralized power plants.

nodes.name: Electric Transmission & Dist
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that own and operate regulated electric transmission and/or distribution assets.

nodes.name: District Heating & Cooling
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that operate regulated district heating and cooling networks on both the municipal and industrial park level.

nodes.name: Gas Utilities
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that operate natural gas transmission and/or distribution networks under either regulated or unregulated revenue arrangements.

nodes.name: Water Utilities
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that operate regulated water distribution networks and own and/or operate treatment infrastructure.

nodes.name: Elec & Gas Marketing & Trading
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes companies that sell and trade electricity, natural gas, and related commodities to end users.
nodes.nameZh: 电力与天然气营销与交易

nodes.name: Supranationals
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes multinational organizations with economic or political objectives that transcend a single country, such as preventing conflicts or providing economic development aid.

nodes.name: Sovereign Government
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes entities that have the highest authority over a defined territory. These are independent governments that can levy taxes, issue debt, and create laws.

nodes.name: Sovereign Agencies
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes entities that provide administration and oversight of specific governmental functions on behalf of sovereign governments. These activities include regulation, law enforcement, tax collection and distribution, social and economic services, international diplomacy, and other country-level support services. Excludes entities in the private sector providing services elsewhere classifiable, such as utilities, rail transportation, or hospitals.

nodes.name: Central Banks
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes entities that issue currency, regulate the money supply, oversee the banking industry, and control the interest rates in a country.

nodes.name: Government Development Banks
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes government-owned entities that provide financing for economic development for a specific country. These entities are typically structured as banks and provide easier access to credit. They may target specific industries or companies that promote governmental objectives.

nodes.name: Export-Import Banks
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes entities that promote a country's foreign trade by providing financing or other financial services, such as insurance and export guarantees.

nodes.name: Regional Government
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes entities that operate political systems for regional subdivisions of a country, such as state and provincial governments. These entities maintain space or territory, levy taxes, issue debt, and create laws within their regional subdivision.

nodes.name: Regional Agencies
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes regional government organizations responsible for the administration and oversight of regulation, law enforcement, tax collection and distribution, social and economic services, and other support services.

nodes.name: Local Government
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes entities that operate political systems for the smallest subdivisions of a country, such as city and township governments. These entities maintain territories, levy taxes, issue debt, and create laws within their local subdivisions.

nodes.name: Local Agencies
nodes.definition: This industry subgroup includes local government organizations responsible for the administration and oversight of regulation, law enforcement, tax collection and distribution, social and economic services, and other support services.

nodes.name: Unknown
nodes.definition: For companies where no information is available to determine business activity.

nodes.name: Corporate Adjustments
nodes.definition: For segments that are reported for corporate adjustments or for administrative office activities. These segments are not considered a part of their business activities.

nodes.name: Intersegment Adjustments
nodes.definition: For segments that adjusts revenue to account for intersegment or non-external revenue sales. These segments are not considered a part of their business activities.

nodes.name: Advertising Agencies & Svcs
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that create advertising campaigns for media use, provide market research or marketing consulting services, or act as public relations or media representatives.
nodes.nameZh: 广告代理商及相关服务

nodes.name: Direct Marketing
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies involved in the creation or distribution of direct marketing advertisements. Includes mail advertisements, telemarketing, coupons, and text (SMS) advertisements.

nodes.name: Cable & Satellite Video Svcs
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that offer cable or satellite television access. Access is usually provided to the customer through a set-top box.

nodes.name: Cable & Satellite Internet Svcs
nodes.definition: This segment includes cable companies that provide Internet and broadband services.
nodes.nameZh: 有线与卫星互联网服务

nodes.name: Cable & Satellite Phone Svcs
nodes.definition: This segment includes cable companies that provide phone services.

nodes.name: Film & TV Production & Distr
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that produce and/or distribute film, videos, television programs, or television commercials.
nodes.nameZh: 电影与电视制作及发行

nodes.name: TV Media Networks
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that aggregate, market, and distribute television programs to TV broadcasting stations, cable companies, satellite companies, and wireline telecommunications companies. Programming may be produced in-house or acquired from external sources.

nodes.name: Royalty Income - Film & TV
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that generate revenue from their film and television assets (such as trademarks, brand names and/or agreements) for which a royalty payment or licensing fee is paid by others.

nodes.name: Integrated Record Prod & Distr
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that release, promote, and distribute sound recordings. These companies manufacture, or arrange for the manufacture of recordings, such as audio tapes/cassettes and compact discs, and promote and distribute these products to wholesalers, retailers, or directly to the public. Companies in this segment produce master recordings themselves or obtain reproduction and distribution rights to master recordings produced by record production companies or other integrated record companies.
nodes.nameZh: 综合录音制品制作与发行

nodes.name: Music Publishers
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that acquire and register copyrights for musical compositions, and promote and authorize the use of these compositions in recordings, radio, television, motion pictures, live performances, print or other media. Companies in this segment represent the interests of the songwriter or other owners of musical compositions to produce revenues from the use of such works, generally through licensing agreements. These companies may own the copyright or act as administrator of the music copyrights on behalf of copyright owners. Publishers of music books and sheet music are included in this segment.

nodes.name: Record Production
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that produce records, tapes, and compact discs. These companies contract with artists and arrange and finance the production of original master recordings. These companies also hold the copyright to the master recording and derive most of their revenues from the sales, leasing, and licensing of master recordings. Such companies do not have their own duplication or distribution capabilities.

nodes.name: Mobile & Online Games
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that primarily publish and distribute video game software for mobile phones or websites.

nodes.name: Console & PC Games
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that publish and distribute video game software for personal computers or video game consoles.

nodes.name: Book Publishers
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that publish and distribute books. These companies provide book design, editing and marketing activities.

nodes.name: Newspaper Publishers
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that produce and distribute newspapers.

nodes.name: Periodical Publishers
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that produce and distribute magazines and other periodicals.

nodes.name: Local TV Broadcasting
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that operate broadcasting studios, stations, and facilities for the transmission of local television programming over public airwaves. Such programming may originate in their own studio, from an affiliated network, or from external sources.

nodes.name: Radio Broadcasting
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that produce, acquire, distribute, or broadcast radio programming. Excludes satellite radio (see "Cable & Satellite").

nodes.name: Automotive Web
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide automotive information and classified listings online.

nodes.name: Dating Services Web
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that offer dating services and other matchmaking services online.

nodes.name: Domain Registrar
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that primarily register Internet domain names.

nodes.name: Entmt Event Ticket Online
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that retail tickets online for entertainment events, such as musical events, sporting events, and theatrical shows.

nodes.name: Photography Web
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide photo posting, printing, and collating services online.

nodes.name: Price & Svc Comparison Web
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide product price comparison services online. Such products include credit card rates, mobile phone rates, holiday prices, flights, digital cameras, and printers.

nodes.name: Real Estate & Property Web
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide real estate and property information and listings online.

nodes.name: Recruitment Services Web
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide recruitment services and online listings for both employers and potential employees.

nodes.name: Travel Info & Booking Web
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that offer travel information and booking services online.

nodes.name: Education Information Web
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide educational information online.

nodes.name: Internet Advertising Portals
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that operate websites that use a search engine to generate and maintain extensive databases of Internet addresses and content in an easily searchable format.

nodes.name: Medical & Health Web
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide medical, health, and fitness content online in an easily searchable format.

nodes.name: News, Sports & Entmt Web
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide news, sports, and entertainment content online in an easily searchable format.

nodes.name: Social Networking Web
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide Web communities online, including social network services, an Internet forum, or a group of blogs.

nodes.name: Online Transport & Delivery Svcs
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that offer transportation or delivery services online or via applications. These companies do not own the mode of transportation.

nodes.name: Wireless Service Providers
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide mobile phone services, such as telephone voice services, data services, text messaging services, and roaming services.

nodes.name: Satellite Operators
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that own and operate satellites. Typically, these satellite operators offer satellite capacity for telecommunication networks or provide geospatial data for their clients.

nodes.name: Mobile Comm Device Revenue
nodes.definition: This segment includes revenue that telecom carriers generate from the sale of mobile handsets and other wireless devices. These devices are frequently sold along with a prepaid or postpaid wireless subscription.

nodes.name: Wireline Phone Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes wireline network operators that offer voice services over a fixed-line network. Includes wireline local and long-distance services as well as voice-over-IP (VoIP) to residential and business customers.

nodes.name: Wireline Internet Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that offer Internet access (including broadband) through a wireline network connection.

nodes.name: Wireline Video Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes wireline network operators that offer video services over a fixed-line network.

nodes.name: Wholesale Telecom Services

nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that wholesale and distribute beer and malt beverages.

nodes.name: Confectionery Wholesalers
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that wholesale and distribute confectioneries, nuts, chips, and fountain syrups.

nodes.name: Dairy Prods Whslrs (ex Dry/Can)
nodes.nameLong: Dairy Products Wholesalers (excluding Dried or Canned)
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that wholesale and distribute dairy products, excluding dried or canned dairy products.
nodes.nameZh: 奶产品批发商(除干制与罐装）

nodes.name: Fish & Seafood Wholesalers
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that wholesale and distribute fish and other seafood.

nodes.name: Fresh Fruit & Vegetable Whslrs
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that wholesale and distribute fresh fruit and vegetables.
nodes.nameZh: 新鲜水果与蔬菜批发商

nodes.name: General-Line Grocery Whslrs
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that wholesale and distribute general groceries.

nodes.name: Meat Products Wholesalers
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that wholesale and distribute fresh meat and other meat products.

nodes.name: Packaged Frozen Food Whslrs
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that wholesale and distribute packaged frozen foods.

nodes.name: Poultry Products Wholesalers
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that wholesale and distribute fresh poultry and poultry-based products.

nodes.name: Tobacco Products Wholesalers
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that wholesale and distribute tobacco and other tobacco-based products.

nodes.name: Wine & Distilled Alcohol Whslrs
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that wholesale and distribute wine and distilled alcoholic beverages.
nodes.nameZh: 葡萄酒及蒸馏酒批发商

nodes.name: Supermarkets
nodes.definition: This segment includes stores that retail a wide range of packaged food, fresh food, and household products.

nodes.name: Specialty Food & Staples Stores
nodes.definition: This segment includes stores that specialize in retailing a specific type of food or beverage product.
nodes.nameZh: 特色食品及必需品商店

nodes.name: Convenience Stores
nodes.definition: This segment includes stores that specialize in retailing a limited selection of everyday consumer staple products.

nodes.name: Pharmacies & Drug Stores
nodes.definition: This segment includes stores that specialize in retailing prescription drugs and medications.

nodes.name: Supercenters
nodes.definition: This segment includes big-box stores that carry a wide selection of general merchandise and food.

nodes.name: Warehouse Clubs
nodes.definition: This segment includes stores that offer a wide variety of merchandise, usually in wholesale quantities, and require an annual membership in order to shop.

nodes.name: Discount Stores
nodes.definition: This segment includes stores that offer a wide range of general merchandise at discounted prices.

nodes.name: Dollar Stores
nodes.definition: This segment includes stores that offer a wide range of general merchandise at a single targeted price-point.

nodes.name: Crude Oil & Natural Gas E&P
nodes.nameLong: Crude Oil & Natural Gas Exploration & Production
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that explore and develop deposits of crude oil and natural gas.
nodes.nameZh: 原油和天然气勘探与生产

nodes.name: Oil & Natural Gas Mkt & Trading
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that market and resell third-party purchased raw crude oil and natural gas volumes.
nodes.nameZh: 石油与天然气营销与交易

nodes.name: Royalty Income - Oil & Gas
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that receive royalties from energy properties, such as oil and gas fields.
nodes.nameZh: 特许权收入-石油和天然气

nodes.name: Oil & Liquid Rich Gas Pipelines
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that own and operate pipelines and terminal facilities for oil and liquid rich gas. Also includes companies that process liquid rich gas into final end products.
nodes.nameZh: 石油与天然气凝析液管道

nodes.name: Dry Natural Gas Pipelines
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that own and operate pipelines for dry natural gas. These companies utilize their distribution network to link raw natural gas processing plants to utilities, liquefied natural gas (LNG) facilities, and other end users.

nodes.name: Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG)
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that operate infrastructure used to for the transport of natural gas in its liquified state. Includes infrastructure used for the liquification, storage, tanker loading and offloading, and regassification of liquefied natural gas (LNG).

nodes.name: Petroleum Refining
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that own and operate refineries which produce refined petroleum product such as gasoline, liquefied petroleum gas, diesel, and kerosene. Excludes petrochemicals (see Organic Chem & Intermediates) or lubricants (see Fluid & Lubricant Additives).

nodes.name: Petroleum Marketing
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide distribution channels for refined petroleum products.

nodes.name: Onshore Drilling
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that drill for oil and natural gas onshore on a contract basis.

nodes.name: Offshore Drilling
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that drill for oil and natural gas offshore on a contract basis. These companies own and operate various drilling rigs in order to provide these services for exploration and production companies.

nodes.name: Drill Support
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide support services for drilling operations or manufacture specialized drilling equipment. Support services include supplying oil country tubular goods, casing, drilling and completion fluids, and equipment to drilling platforms. Also includes services such as cementing, logging-while-drilling, specialty waste management, inspection, and transportation services. Specialized drilling hardware and equipment includes drill bits, reamers, and stabilizers.

nodes.name: Onshore Oilfield Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide oilfield services and equipment in onshore applications.

nodes.name: Subsea & Offshore Oilfield Svcs
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide oilfield services and equipment in offshore and subsea applications. Includes underwater installation, inspection, repair, and decommissioning services of subsea pipelines, wells, and umbilicals.

nodes.name: Seismic Surveying
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that survey oil and natural gas fields through seismic technology.

nodes.name: Biofuel Feedstock Suppliers
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that produce raw material feedstock for biofuel production.

nodes.name: Diesel Substitutes
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that produce diesel substitutes primarily from vegetable oil or animal fats.

nodes.name: Gasoline Substitutes
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that produce ethanol fuel additives, typically made from corn or sugar.

nodes.name: Solar Energy Equipment
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture equipment used to capture solar energy, such as polysilicon feedstock, photovoltaic (PV) panels, PV cells, PV modules, thin film modules, concentrated photovoltaics, crystalline silicon wafers, and related equipment.

nodes.name: Wind Energy Equipment
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture equipment used to capture wind energy, such as wind-power generation machinery, towers, and components.

nodes.name: Geothermal Energy Equipment
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture equipment used to capture geothermal energy, such as thermoelectric generators and other geothermal energy components.

nodes.name: Hydro Energy Equipment
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture equipment used to capture energy from the storage and movement of water.

nodes.name: Marine Energy Equipment
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture equipment used to capture energy from the ocean, such as ocean thermal convertors, wave energy convertors, tidal stream turbines, and other marine energy equipment components.

nodes.name: Other Renewable Energy Equip
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture equipment used to capture energy from renewable energy sources not elsewhere classified, as well as equipment used to improve the efficiency of electricity use and storage.

nodes.name: Development & Construction
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that develop, build, and manage renewable energy projects.

nodes.name: Operations & Maintenance
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide operations and maintenance services for renewable energy projects, including repair and day-to-day upkeep of these sites.

nodes.name: Corporate Banking
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that accept deposits and make loans to corporations and large businesses.

nodes.name: Retail Banking
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that accept deposits and make loans to retail (individual) customers.

nodes.name: Islamic Banking
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that accept deposits and make loans in compliance with Sharia law.

nodes.name: Investment Holding Companies
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that hold securities of other companies for investment purposes.

nodes.name: BDCs
nodes.definition: This segment includes business development companies (BDCs). A BDC provides capital and management to primarily private small- and medium-sized companies that may not be able to obtain traditional financing. A company must qualify as a BDC. Companies with other similar structures are included.

nodes.name: Blank Check
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that operate as blank check or blank shell companies. Blank check companies have no business operations but go public with the intention of merging or acquiring a company with the proceeds of the IPO. Includes Special Purpose Acquisition Companies (SPACs) and Capital Pool Companies (CPCs).

nodes.name: Cryptocurrency Investment Co
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that mine cryptocurrency or hold cryptocurrency as an investment.

nodes.name: Equities
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide traditional investment management services for individual and institutional investors by investing in equities.

nodes.name: Fixed Income
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide traditional investment management services for individual and institutional investors by investing in fixed income investments.

nodes.name: Hedge Fund Investments
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide investment management services for individual and institutional investors by investing in a diverse range of assets, such as equities, bonds, and commodities. Hedge funds employ a variety of investment strategies to maintain a hedged portfolio designed to protect investors from downturns in the market and maximize returns in upward markets.

nodes.name: Mixed Asset
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide traditional investment management services for individual and institutional investors by investing in a mixed asset portfolio. A mixed asset fund invests in a mix of bonds and equities to spread the investment risk.

nodes.name: Co-Investments
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that invest in a co-investment asset class of private equity financial sponsors.

nodes.name: Debt Investments
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that invest in the fixed income asset class of private equity financial sponsors. These debt investments will provide rescue financing to companies undergoing operational or financial challenges.

nodes.name: Fund of Funds
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that operate a fund of funds investment strategy. A fund of funds holds a portfolio composed of investments in other fund types and does not hold direct investments.

nodes.name: Growth Capital
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide growth capital investments. Typically, these are minority investments that are provided to companies that are more mature in their life-cycle development with positive cash flow. These investments may be utilized for facility expansions, product development, or equipment.

nodes.name: Leveraged Buyout
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that invest in a leveraged buyout asset class of private equity financial sponsors.

nodes.name: Real Assets Investments
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that invest in an infrastructure asset class of private equity financial sponsors. An infrastructure investment includes transportation, water and waste, and natural resources investments.

nodes.name: Real Estate Investments
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that invest in a real estate asset class of private equity financial sponsors. A real estate investment consists of equity and debt investments in property that involves an active management strategy.

nodes.name: Secondary Transactions
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that invest in a secondary transaction asset class of private equity financial sponsors. A secondary transaction investment consists of buying and selling of preexisting investor commitments to private equity and other alternative investment funds. Types of secondary transaction investments are the sale of a limited partnership interest and the sale of a direct interest.

nodes.name: Venture Capital
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide venture capital investments. Such investments are provided to early-stage, high-potential, high-risk, growth startup companies.

nodes.name: Financial Plan & Invst Advisory
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide financial planning and investment advice to clients on a fee basis but do not have authority to execute trades. Financial planning involves creating and preserving personal wealth, retirement planning, and tax- and estate-planning services.

nodes.name: Private Banking
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide personalized banking services to high-net-worth individuals.

nodes.name: Retail Securities Brokerage
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide securities brokerage services to retail investors.

nodes.name: Comml Equip Finance & Leasing
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that finance or lease equipment used by commercial or industrial users. In such a situation, a contractual agreement is established and usually reached through a dealer.

nodes.name: Transp Equip Finance & Leasing
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide loans for purchase or contracts permitting the use of transportation such as aircraft, railroad cars, and ocean vessels.

nodes.name: Auto Finance
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that originate, service, and/or collect auto loans to consumers.

nodes.name: Consumer Microlending
