nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide small amount lending to consumers, including payday loans and pawn shop loans. These loans often are made to consumers who have limited access to credit, are short term in duration, have fixed fees and have easy and fast processing.

nodes.name: Credit Card Lending
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that issue credit cards.

nodes.name: Student Lending
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that originate, service, and/or collect student loans for educational purposes.

nodes.name: Mortgage Lenders
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide home financing, such as mortgages and home equity loans.

nodes.name: Mortgage Loan Brokers
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that arrange home loans between borrowers and lenders on a commission or fee basis.

nodes.name: Mortgage Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide mortgage services other than mortgage lending or mortgage brokerage services.

nodes.name: Mortgage Insurance
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide insurance to cover losses from defaults on mortgage loans. Also known as private mortgage insurance (PMI).

nodes.name: Title Insurance
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that directly underwrite title insurance policies.

nodes.name: Mortgage REIT
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that invest in real estate loans and related securities, and meet the criteria necessary to be eligible for real estate investment trust (REIT) tax status.

nodes.name: Receivables Collection & Mgmt
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that collect payments for claims. Collected payments are remitted to the company's clients or kept by the company if the company has purchased the claims.

nodes.name: Financial Transaction Processors
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that process or facilitate financial transactions. Includes companies that process credit cards, debit cards, or gift cards payments and credit card networks.

nodes.name: Financial Info Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide financial data and information.

nodes.name: Investment Banking
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide financial advisory and securities underwriting services on a fee basis.

nodes.name: Security & Commodity Brokerage
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that facilitate the buying and selling of securities on a commission or fee per basis.

nodes.name: Trading & Principal Investment
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that buy and sell equities, fixed income, currencies, commodities, and related securities for client-driven and proprietary trading.

nodes.name: Asset & Investment Servicing
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide investment and other asset services on a fee basis and fund administration.

nodes.name: Execution & Clearing Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide trade execution and clearance services on a fee basis.

nodes.name: Issuer Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide securities issuance and related services on a fee basis.

nodes.name: Transaction Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide cash management, funds transfer, or liquidity management services on a fee basis.

nodes.name: Life Insurance Premiums
nodes.definition: This segment includes premium income generated from life insurance products, including life, accidental death, disability, and annuities.

nodes.name: Life Insurance Non-Premium
nodes.definition: This segment includes total non-premium revenue generated from direct life business.

nodes.name: P&C Insurance Premiums
nodes.definition: This segment includes premium revenue generated from underwriting property and casualty insurance policies. Includes automobile, property damage, casualty, theft, fire, malpractice, marine, workers' compensation, and homeowners insurance.

nodes.name: P&C Insurance Non-Premium
nodes.definition: This segment includes total non-premium revenue generated from direct property and casualty insurance.
nodes.nameZh: 财产与意外保险非保费

nodes.name: Health Insurance - Islamic
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that directly underwrite health insurance policies in compliance with Islamic law.

nodes.name: Life Insurance - Islamic
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that directly underwrite life insurance policies in compliance with Islamic law, including life, accidental death, disability, and annuities (pensions).

nodes.name: P&C Insurance - Islamic
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that directly underwrite property and casualty insurance policies in compliance with Islamic law. Includes automobile, property damage, casualty, theft, fire, malpractice, marine, workers' compensation, and homeowners insurance.
nodes.nameZh: 财产与意外保险-伊斯兰

nodes.name: Life Reinsurance
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that underwrite reinsurance for life insurance policies. Insurance types include life, accidental death, disability and annuities (pensions).

nodes.name: P&C Reinsurance
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that underwrite reinsurance for property and casualty insurance policies. Insurance types include automobile, property damage, casualty, theft, fire, malpractice, marine, workers' compensation and homeowners insurance.

nodes.name: Apartment Owners & Develop
nodes.definition: This segment includes non-REIT owners and developers of apartments that typically have 5+ units.

nodes.name: Mfgd Housing Owners & Develop
nodes.definition: This segment includes non-REIT owners and developers of pad sites and mobile/manufactured homes. This also includes companies that operate resort communities where clients bring their own RVs and pay a fee to rent ground space/pad sites.

nodes.name: Student Housing Own & Develop
nodes.definition: This segment includes non-REIT owners and developers of student housing. Such housing is any for-rent housing that is available to students only.
nodes.nameZh: 学生住宅业主与开发商

nodes.name: Bulk Warehouse Own & Develop
nodes.definition: This segment includes non-REIT owners and developers of high-ceiling industrial properties used for distribution, warehousing, and manufacturing.
nodes.nameZh: 散货仓库业主与开发商

nodes.name: Flex Industrial Own & Develop
nodes.definition: This segment includes non-REIT owners and developers of flex space, which can accommodate office, light manufacturing, R&D, and/or storage usage in the same unit.
nodes.nameZh: 灵活产业业主与开发商

nodes.name: Temp Control Logist Own & Dev
nodes.definition: This segment includes non-REIT owners and developers of temperature-controlled industrial, warehouse, or distribution facilities. Such facilities are equipped to accommodate temperature adjustment, refrigeration and/or freezing needs.
nodes.nameZh: 控温物流业主与开发商

nodes.name: CBD Office Own & Developers
nodes.nameLong: Central Business District (CBD) Office Owners & Developers
nodes.definition: This segment includes non-REIT owners and developers of office buildings in central business districts (CBDs). Outside of the U.S., if the office is not identified as being in a CBD, the number of stories in the building will be used to determine whether it is CBD (5 or more stories) or suburban (less than 5 stories).

nodes.name: Suburban Office Own & Develop
nodes.definition: This segment includes non-REIT owners and developers of office buildings in the suburbs. Outside of the U.S., if the office is not identified as being in a CBD, the number of stories in the building will be used to determine whether it is CBD (5 or more stories) or suburban (less than 5 stories).
nodes.nameZh: 医疗办公楼业主与开发商

nodes.name: Regional Malls Own & Develop
nodes.definition: This segment includes non-REIT owners and developers of mall space. These malls, also known as shopping malls, typically have retail stores that are enclosed within a large, single building.
nodes.nameZh: 地区购物商城业主与开发商

nodes.name: Shopping Center Own & Develop
nodes.definition: This segment includes non-REIT owners and developers of shopping centers. These shopping centers typically encompass multiple stand-alone retail buildings within a self-contained lot.
nodes.nameZh: 购物中心业主与开发商

nodes.name: Single Tenant Own & Develop
nodes.definition: This segment includes non-REIT owners and developers of standalone retail buildings that serves a single retail tenant, such as gas station sites or stand-alone restaurant buildings.
nodes.nameZh: 单一租户业主与开发商

nodes.name: Hospital REIT
nodes.definition: This segment includes real estate investment trusts (REITs) that own and develop hospitals.

nodes.name: Medical Office REIT
nodes.definition: This segment includes real estate investment trusts (REITs) that own and develop medical office buildings that primarily house medical practices and health care testing services.

nodes.name: Senior Housing REIT
nodes.definition: This segment includes real estate investment trusts (REITs) that own and develop senior housing, such as retirement living communities and assisted living facilities.

nodes.name: Skilled Nursing REIT
nodes.definition: This segment includes real estate investment trusts (REITs) that own and develop nursing homes.

nodes.name: Apartment REIT
nodes.definition: This segment includes real estate investment trusts (REITs) that own and develop apartments that typically have 5+ units.

nodes.name: Single Family Housing REIT
nodes.definition: This segment includes real estate investment trusts (REITs) that own and develop single family homes.

nodes.name: Manufactured Housing REIT
nodes.definition: This segment includes real estate investment trusts (REITs) that own and develop pad sites and mobile/manufactured homes. This also includes REITs that operate resort communities where clients bring their own RVs and pay a fee to rent ground space/pad sites.

nodes.name: Student Housing REIT
nodes.definition: This segment includes real estate investment trusts (REITs) that own and develop student housing. Such housing is any for-rent housing that is available only to students.

nodes.name: Bulk Warehouse REIT
nodes.definition: This segment includes real estate investment trusts (REITs) that own and develop high-ceiling industrial properties used for distribution, warehousing, and manufacturing.

nodes.name: Flex Industrial REIT
nodes.definition: This segment includes real estate investment trusts (REITS) that own and develop flex space, which can accomodate office, light manufacturing, R&D, and/or storage usage in the same unit.

nodes.name: Temp Control Logistics REIT
nodes.definition: This segment includes real estate investment trusts (REITS) that own and develop temperature-controlled industrial, warehouse or distribution facilities. Such facilities are equipped to accommodate temperature adjustment, refrigeration and/or freezing needs.

nodes.name: CBD Office REIT
nodes.definition: This segment includes real estate investment trusts (REITs) that own and develop office buildings in central business districts (CBDs). Outside of the U.S., if the office is not identified as being in a CBD, the number of stories in the building will be used to determine whether it is CBD (5 or more stories) or suburban (less than 5 stories).

nodes.name: Suburban Office REIT
nodes.definition: This segment includes real estate investment trusts (REITs) that own and develop office buildings in the suburbs. Outside of the U.S., if the office is not identified as being in a CBD, the number of stories in the building will be used to determine whether it is CBD (5 or more stories) or suburban (less than 5 stories).

nodes.name: Regional Mall REIT
nodes.definition: This segment includes real estate investment trusts (REITs) that own and develop mall spaces. These malls, also known as shopping malls, typically have retail stores that are enclosed within a large, single building.

nodes.name: Shopping Center REIT
nodes.definition: This segment includes real estate investment trusts (REITs) that own and develop shopping centers. These shopping centers typically encompass multiple stand-alone retail buildings within a self-contained lot.

nodes.name: Single Tenant REIT
nodes.definition: This segment includes real estate investment trusts (REITs) that own and develop stand-alone retail buildings that serve single retail tenants, such as stand-alone gas stations or restaurants.

nodes.name: Property Management
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide property management services, including building maintenance and security and bill payment services.

nodes.name: Real Estate Brokerage
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide brokerage services between a lessee and the property owner for a fee. These companies may represent either side of a transaction and may provide marketing services. These companies do not own the underlying property.

nodes.name: Specialty Pharma
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that specialize in developing, manufacturing and marketing pharmaceuticals. Includes veterinary medicine.

nodes.name: Generic Pharma
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that specialize in manufacturing generic pharmaceuticals and their active ingredients. These companies manufacture off-patent drugs, which require minimal or no R&D or marketing.

nodes.name: Hospitals
nodes.definition: This segment includes medical facilities that provide short and long term medical and diagnostic testing and treatments.

nodes.name: Nursing & Residential Care
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide nursing and residential care facilities. Includes nursing care facilities, continuing care retirement communities, homes for the elderly and homes for the mentally handicapped.

nodes.name: Psych & Substance Abuse Hosp
nodes.definition: This segment includes hospitals that provide psychiatric and substance abuse services to patients.

nodes.name: Specialty Facilities
nodes.definition: This segment includes facilities that provide diagnostic and medical treatment to patients with a specific type of disease.

nodes.name: Contract Research
nodes.definition: This segment includes service organizations that support the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industries by providing outsourced pharmaceutical research and manufacturing services.

nodes.name: Health Care Testing Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide health care testing services, such as medical laboratories, diagnostic imaging centers, clinical trial services, and biotechnology research and development services.

nodes.name: Outpatient Health Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide outpatient health care services. Such services are provided by various practitioners such as doctors and dentists, in outpatient health care facilities, and by outpatient home nursing services.

nodes.name: Veterinary Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide veterinary services.

nodes.name: Health Care Distribution
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that wholesale and distribute health care products to providers, retail outlets, or end consumers.

nodes.name: Pharmacy Benefits Mgmt (PBM)
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide pharmacy benefit management (PBM) services. Includes prescription drug benefit programs, retail network pharmacy management, retail drug card programs, home delivery pharmacy services, benefit design consultation, drug utilization review, and claims processing.

nodes.name: Managed Care Comml Business
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide managed health care services through a health maintenance organization (HMO) structure to commercial clients.

nodes.name: Managed Care Disease Mgmt
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide disease management and wellness program services.

nodes.name: Managed Care Govt Business
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide managed health care services through a health maintenance organization (HMO) structure to participants of government programs.
nodes.nameZh: 管理式医疗 政府事务

nodes.name: Ophthalmic Goods
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture ophthalmic goods, such as eyeglasses, contact lenses, sunglasses, eyeglass frames, and protective eyewear.

nodes.name: Surgical Appliances & Supplies
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture medical supplies used or consumed in surgery, such as bandages, dressings, tape, sutures, and syringes.

nodes.name: Life Science Equipment
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture analytical laboratory instruments used to analyze the chemical or physical composition of samples of materials.

nodes.name: In Vitro Diagnostics
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture in-vitro (not internal) diagnostic substances. These substances are used for diagnostic tests that are performed in test tubes, petri dishes, and machines.

nodes.name: Cardiovascular Devices
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture electromedical and interventional cardiovascular devices that use electrical impulses to stimulate action. Includes pacemakers, implantable cardioverter-defibrillators (ICDs), ventricle assist devices (VADs), defibrillators, drug-eluting stents, bare-metal stents, heart valves, coronary stent grafts, cardiac surgery products, and any other cardiovascular device that is not disposable and is not a heart monitor.

nodes.name: Neuromodulation Devices
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture neuromodulation devices, including neurostimulation devices and implantable drug infusion systems.

nodes.name: Orthopedic Devices
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that produce reconstructive and spinal devices that are used to repair lost joint function (orthopedic devices), spinal conditions (spinal implants), and damaged bones and tissue (bone cement and fixation devices such as screws, pins, plates, etc.). Includes hip and knee implants, spinal plates and screws, orthobiologics, bone cement, and dental devices.

nodes.name: Cosmetic Surgical Equipment
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture surgical equipment and supplies used in invasive and non-invasive cosmetic procedures.

nodes.name: Dental Equipment
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture dental equipment and supplies. Includes dental hand instruments, dental chairs, and dental lighting.

nodes.name: Medication Monitor & Delivery
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture products used to deliver therapeutic dosages or monitor endocrine levels in the body.

nodes.name: Radiation Equipment
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture irradiation apparatus equipment and related supplies. Includes x-ray equipment devices.

nodes.name: Surgical & Medical Instruments
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture any medical devices, instruments, or equipment used in surgery or recovery that is not elsewhere classified.

nodes.name: Aircraft
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture or assemble commercial aircraft and helicopters, including complete aircraft overhauls and rebuilding.

nodes.name: Aircraft Parts
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture aircraft engines, aircraft engine parts, aircraft seats and seat frames, aircraft sub-assemblies (such as wings, fuselage, airframes, and tails), and aircraft electronics (such as radar or guidance systems).

nodes.name: Military Aircraft
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture or assemble military aircraft and helicopters, including complete aircraft overhauls and rebuilding.

nodes.name: Military Armored Veh & Tanks
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture military armored vehicles, tanks, self-propelled vehicles, and tank components.

nodes.name: Missile & Space Vehicles
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture guided missiles and space vehicles and/or their engines and/or their parts and components.

nodes.name: Munitions & Accessories
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture munitions, ordnances, and small arms.

nodes.name: Naval Ships
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture naval ships, boats, and submarines.

nodes.name: Electronics & Mission Systems
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture finished electronic systems utilized in defense applications. Includes command center communication systems, military vehicle navigation systems, and reconnaissance equipment.

nodes.name: Elevator & Moving Stairway
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture equipment that moves materials or passengers from one floor to another floor. Such equipment includes automobile lifts, passenger elevators, and escalators.

nodes.name: HVAC Building Products
nodes.nameLong: Heating, Ventilation & A/C Building Products Manufacturing
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture affixed ventilation, heating, air conditioning, and commercial and industrial walk-in refrigeration and freezer equipment. Excludes portable or consumer HVAC equipment (see Heating & Cooling Appliances).

nodes.name: Lighting Fixtures
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture electric lamp bulbs, lighting fixtures, and parts.

nodes.name: Security Devices
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture security devices, such as motion sensors and fire detectors.

nodes.name: Electric Vehicle Supply Equip
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture equipment used to supply electricity to electric vehicles.

nodes.name: Power Generation Equipment
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture equipment used in both primary and secondary power generation.

nodes.name: Power Trans & Distr Equip
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture equipment utilized in the transmission and distribution of power. This equipment is primarily used in electricity infrastructure.

nodes.name: Manufacturing Auto Controls
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture systems and devices used to automate, monitor, and optimize manufacturing. Excludes automation controls directly involved in manufacturing of goods (see Factory Automation Equipment).

nodes.name: Process Automation Controls
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture systems and devices used to automate, monitor, and optimize non-manufacturing industrial processes. These processes include oil and gas, chemical, mining and other non-manufacturing processes.

nodes.name: Elec Measuring Instruments
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture instruments used to measure and test the characteristics of electricity and electrical systems. Such instruments include circuit and continuity testers, voltmeters, and watt meters.

nodes.name: Fluid Meter & Counting Devices
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture devices used to count and register variables, such as gas and water consumption.

nodes.name: Measuring & Control Devices
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture instruments and related devices for measuring, displaying, indicating, recording, transmitting, and controlling industrial process variables.

nodes.name: Electronic Coil
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture electronic inductors, such as coils and transformers. Excludes electronic coils for power transmission or distribution (see Power Trans & Distr Components).

nodes.name: Electronic Connectors
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture electronic connectors.

nodes.name: Industrial Electronics Equip
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture electronics equipment and components used in industrial applications, as opposed to technological or communication applications. For these latter applications, see the categories under Technology Hardware.

nodes.name: Wire & Cable
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture current-carrying wiring and cable. Excludes fiber optic cables utilized for telecommunication (see Fiber Optic Equipment).

nodes.name: Farm Machinery & Equipment
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture farm tractors and other farm equipment.

nodes.name: Home Lawn & Garden Equipment
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture equipment used for non-commercial home and landscaping applications. Includes tractors or lawn mowers (under 40 hp), leaf blowers, hedge trimmers, and snow blowers.

nodes.name: Agricultural Mach Parts & Svcs
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide parts and aftermarket services for farm machinery and equipment. Includes maintenance services, as well as manufacturing of spare parts and aftermarket consumables.
nodes.nameZh: 农用机械零部件与服务

nodes.name: Construction Machinery
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture construction equipment. Such equipment includes crawler tractors, hydraulic excavators, wheel loaders, rigid and articulated haulers, rubber-tracked loaders, skid steer loaders, loader backhoes, mini excavators, pavers, compactors, motor graders, and cranes.

nodes.name: Mining Machinery & Equipment
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture elevators and conveyors for outdoor use, boring and cutting machinery, mortar mixers, and earth movers.

nodes.name: Const & Mining Mach Parts & Svcs
nodes.nameLong: Construction & Mining Machinery Parts Manufacturing & Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide parts and aftermarket services for construction and mining machinery. Includes maintenance services, as well as manufacturing of spare parts and aftermarket consumables.
nodes.nameZh: 建筑与采矿机械零部件与服务

nodes.name: Industrial Engines
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture combustion piston engines for use in industrial engines, such as steam, hydraulic, wind and gas turbines. They may also manufacture engines for marine craft and rail trains. Excludes airplane, vehicle or motorcycle engines.

nodes.name: Power Transmission & Gear
nodes.nameLong: Mechanical Power Transmission Equipment & Gear Manufacturing
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture transmissions and related components.

nodes.name: Gear
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture gears used in drivetrain components for various applications.

nodes.name: Ind Process Automation Mach
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture industrial process automation machinery. Such machinery includes systems designed to monitor and respond to industrial variables in the production process.

nodes.name: Industrial Robot
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture industrial robots, such as robots used to manufacture vehicles and computers.

nodes.name: Relay & Industrial Control
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture relay and industrial control machinery. Includes electromagnetic brakes and clutches, armature relays, crane and hoist controls, and solenoid switches.

nodes.name: Factory Automation Parts & Svcs
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide parts and aftermarket services for factory automation equipment. Includes maintenance services, as well as manufacturing of spare parts and aftermarket consumables.
nodes.nameZh: 工厂自动化零部件与服务

nodes.name: Air & Gas Compressor
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture equipment that increases the pressure of air or gas through a pipe.

nodes.name: Fluid Power Cylinder & Actuator
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture cylinders and actuators that are used to convert fluid power to linear or rotary mechanical power.

nodes.name: Fluid Power Pump & Motor
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture pumps and motors that convert mechanical power to fluid power, for example in hydraulic lifts.

nodes.name: Fluid Power Valve
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture valves that regulate the passage of fluids through the use of hydraulics or thermostatic controls.

nodes.name: Industrial Valve
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture valves that regulate the passage of fluids in industrial applications.

nodes.name: Measuring & Dispensing Pump
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture pumps used for measuring and dispensing fluids, for example in chemical plants.

nodes.name: Pump & Pumping Equipment
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture equipment used to move fluids over distances, for example in oil or utility pipelines.

nodes.name: Flow Control Equip Parts & Svcs
nodes.nameLong: Flow Control Equipment Parts Manufacturing & Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide parts and aftermarket services for flow control equipment. Includes maintenance services, as well as manufacturing of spare parts and aftermarket consumables.
nodes.nameZh: 流量控制设备零部件与服务

nodes.name: Comml & Service Ind Machinery
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture machinery used in the commercial and service industries. Includes automatic vending machines and commercial laundry machines.

nodes.name: Food Product Machinery
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture machinery used to produce foods and beverages.

nodes.name: Paper Industry Machinery
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture machinery for making paper pulp, paper, and paperboard.

nodes.name: Plastics & Rubber Machinery
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture extruders, molders, and pneumatic tire-making or retreading machines for specific types of plastic or rubber products.

nodes.name: Printing Machinery & Equip
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture printing and bookbinding machinery. Includes bookbinding, collating, lithographic, offset printing, and typesetting machinery.

nodes.name: Sawmill & Woodworking Mach
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture sawmills and woodworking machinery, such as band saws, drill presses, and bench and table saws.

nodes.name: Textile Machinery
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture machines for producing, extruding, drawing, and texturing fibers, materials, or yarn. Includes cotton gins, bale breakers, garnetters, cotton spreaders, wool scourers, combs, spinning machines, reelers, warpers, and looms.

nodes.name: Tools
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture hand tools. Includes powered and non-powered hand tools and saws, as well as saw blades.

nodes.name: General Purpose Machinery
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture general purpose machinery that is not elsewhere classified.

nodes.name: Packaging Machinery
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture packaging machinery, such as canning and bottling machinery, bottle washers, bag opening, filling and closing machines, food packaging machinery, and labeling and wrapping machinery.

nodes.name: Recycling Equipment & Machinery
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture equipment and machinery for handling and processing recycled materials. These instruments are used in the removal, conveying, sorting, shredding, reduction, destruction, compacting, and baling of recyclable products in the paper, metal, plastic, textile, clothing, or curbside collection industries.

nodes.name: Other Machinery Parts & Svcs
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide parts and aftermarket services for other machinery. Includes maintenance services, as well as manufacturing of spare parts and aftermarket consumables.
nodes.nameZh: 其他机械零部件与服务

nodes.name: Conveyor & Conveying Equip
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture equipment that moves materials from one location to another. Includes belt conveyors, chain conveyors, overhead conveyors, bucket conveyors, and various other conveyors.

nodes.name: Industrial Trucks & Stackers
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture equipment used to lift and move materials, such as forklifts and pallet stackers, loaders, and unloaders.

nodes.name: Overhead Crane
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture equipment that runs along a horizontal beam to move items from one place to another. Includes hoists and monorail systems. Excludes mobile or construction cranes (see Construction Machinery).

nodes.name: Cutting & Machine Tool Acc
nodes.nameLong: Cutting Tool & Machine Tool Accessories Manufacturing
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture tool holders and cutting, drilling, and boring accessories.

nodes.name: Industrial Mold
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture metal molds and die castings.

nodes.name: Machine Tool (Metal Cutting)
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture equipment used to make industrial equipment, such as machines to cut, bore, and drill metal materials.

nodes.name: Machine Tool (Metal Forming)
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture machine tools that form metal by milling, planing, pressing, or grinding metal into the desired shape.

nodes.name: Rolling Mill Mach & Equipment
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture equipment used to cut, form, stamp and bend metal with a pair of rolls. Includes bar mill machinery, cold and hot rolling machinery, and galvanizing machinery.

nodes.name: Sheet Metal Processing Mach
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture sheet metal processing machines used to cut holes in, weld, and bend metal sheets.

nodes.name: Special Die & Tool Fixture
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture specialty tools and fixtures, such as dies and jigs.

nodes.name: Stamping Press Machinery
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture stamping presses to shape or cut metal.

nodes.name: Welding & Solder Equipment
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture equipment used to join metal materials together. Includes arc welding, gas welding, spot welding, and other types of welding and soldering equipment.
nodes.nameZh: 定位焊接与软焊接设备

nodes.name: Air Purification Equipment
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture air purification equipment products used to reduce air pollution by removing contaminates before they are released into the atmosphere. Includes flue gas emission reduction equipment, scrubbers, cyclones, electrostatic precipitators, mist collectors, incinerators, catalytic reactors, biofilters, and activated carbon products used for air purification. Excludes companies that manufacture membrane-based filters (see Filtration Prods - Air & Liquids).

nodes.name: Filtration Prods - Air & Liquids
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture membrane-based filters for air and/or water purification. Also includes manufacturers of liquid separation equipment.

nodes.name: Water Purification Equipment
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture water purification equipment. Includes water treatment systems equipment, water purification chemicals, biofilters, and activated carbon products used for water purification. Excludes companies that manufacture membrane-based filters (see Filtration Prods - Air & Liquids).

nodes.name: Commercial Vehicles Mfg
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture on-highway commercial vehicles. This typically includes class 5 through class 8 commercial vehicles. Excludes vehicles for retail consumers (see Automobiles).

nodes.name: Commercial Vehicle Parts & Svcs
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies the manufacture other parts and components for on-highway commercial vehicles. Includes brake systems, transmission, suspension, doors, steering, wheels and tires, and interior parts and accessories.
nodes.nameZh: 商用车辆零部件与服务

nodes.name: Truck Trailers
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture trailers for on-highway commercial vehicles.

nodes.name: Locomotives
nodes.definition: This segment includes all types of rail-rolling stock locomotives for both suburban and trans-urban railway networks.

nodes.name: Rolling Stock - Railcars
nodes.definition: This segment includes all types of rail-rolling stock for both suburban and trans-urban railway networks in both commercial and passenger transportation spaces.

nodes.name: Rolling Stock Components & Sys
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture rolling stock components and systems. This may include electronic systems and mechanical components.
nodes.nameZh: 机车车辆零部件与系统

nodes.name: Rail Track Components & Sys
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture parts and systems for railway infrastructure networks, including switching systems and fasteners.

nodes.name: Shipbuilding & Repair
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture and repair ships for commercial use.

nodes.name: Marine Parts & Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide parts and aftermarket services for ships. Includes maintenance services, as well as manufacturing of spare parts and aftermarket consumables.

nodes.name: Hardware
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture generic, semi-finished metal products with broad applications.

nodes.name: Fabricated Metal
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that specialize in metalworking processes and use their specializations to manufacture semi-finished materials or metal products. Also includes companies that specialize in manufacturing custom metal products.

nodes.name: Plastic Products
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that specialize in plastic manufacturing processes. Typically, these companies produce intermediate goods with industrial applications.

nodes.name: Rubber Products
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that specialize in manufacturing rubber products.

nodes.name: Industrial Machinery Whslrs
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that wholesale and distribute industrial machinery and parts.

nodes.name: Industrial Equip & Sply Whslrs
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that wholesale and distribute supplies and equipment.
nodes.nameZh: 工业设备与物资批发商

nodes.name: Industrial Rental Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that rent equipment, machinery, or vehicles for industrial or commercial use.

nodes.name: Elec Precision Equip Maint
nodes.definition: This segment includes establishments that repair and maintain electronic and precision equipment.
nodes.nameZh: 电子和精密设备修理和维护

nodes.name: Industrial Mach Equip Repair
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that repair and maintain industrial machinery and equipment.

nodes.name: Energy Facilities & Ntwrk Maint
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide maintenance and repair services for electric utility networks, power generation facilities, pipelines and refineries.

nodes.name: Facility Repair & Maintenance
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide building repair and maintenance services. Typically, these services are offered in an outsourcing model for property owners. These services include minor building repairs, painting, light fixture replacements and general handyman services. These companies may also hire and manage subcontractors, such as plumbers, electricians and HVAC specialists for more specialized services.

nodes.name: Janitorial Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that clean building interiors and/or exteriors. Also includes companies that clean transportation equipment and facilities.

nodes.name: Landscaping Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that perform planting, care, and maintenance for lawns and flower beds for both commercial and residential properties. Excludes companies that specialize in landscaping projects requiring significant engineering expertise (see Engineering Services).

nodes.name: Pest Control Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide pest elimination, prevention, or deterrence services. Excludes pest control services for agricultural purposes (see Support Services - Crop Prod).

nodes.name: Caterers
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that offer single-event food services.

nodes.name: Food Service Contractors
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide food services to institutional, governmental, commercial, or industrial clients, usually on a contractual basis.

nodes.name: Newspaper, Book & Mag Printing
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide newspaper, book, and magazine printing and binding services.

nodes.name: Printing Support
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide printing support services.

nodes.name: Investigation Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide investigation and detective services.

nodes.name: Security Guards Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide guard and patrol services.

nodes.name: Security System Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that install, maintain, and operate security systems. Typically, these companies provide comprehensive security monitoring and alerting services for commercial and household clients.

nodes.name: Correctional Facilities
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that own and/or operate correctional facilities, such as prisons or jails.

nodes.name: Auction Houses & Art Dealers
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that operate auction houses and commercial art galleries owned by art dealers. Excludes online auction marketplaces (see Electronic Auctions).

nodes.name: Convention & Trade Show Org
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that organize, promote, and manage events for business trade shows, conventions, and conferences.

nodes.name: Geophysical Survey & Map Svcs
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that gather, interpret, and map geophysical data.

nodes.name: Interior Design
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that create and develop design based on specifications that optimize the appearance, branding, and efficiency of interior space through the use of textiles, furniture, color selections, and surface finishes.

nodes.name: Parking Lots & Garages
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide parking lot facility management services. These companies provide outsourced parking lot operations for property owners.

nodes.name: Testing Laboratories
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that perform physical, chemical, and other analytical testing services, such as acoustics or vibration testing, biological testing, calibration testing, electrical and electronic testing, mechanical testing, nondestructive testing, or thermal testing. The testing may occur in a laboratory or on-site.

nodes.name: Uniform Rental
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that rent uniforms.

nodes.name: Hazardous Waste Collect & Treat
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide hazardous waste collection and treatment services. It also includes companies that provide oil and hydrocarbon collection and recycling.

nodes.name: Recyclable Materials
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that wholesale waste and scrap materials for recycling. Includes activities such as collecting, sorting, separating, and stripping used goods for reusable parts.

nodes.name: Solid Waste Collection & Treat
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide solid waste collection and treatment services, such as the collection, treatment, and disposal of solid waste and recyclable materials.

nodes.name: Legal Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes groups or organizations of lawyers who provide expertise in a range of specific areas of law, such as criminal, family, estate, patent, real estate, or tax law.

nodes.name: Mgmt & Admin Consulting Svcs
nodes.definition: This segment includes organizations that provide advice and assistance to businesses and other organizations on management issues, such as organizational planning, financial planning and budgeting, marketing, human resources, business process outsourcing, and other third-party services.

nodes.name: Other Professional Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes organizations that provide professional services not elsewhere classified.

nodes.name: Full Service Airline
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide traditional full-service hub-and-spoke scheduled passenger flights.

nodes.name: Low Cost Airline
nodes.definition: This segment includes airlines that operate under a low-cost business model. Such a model may include providing low ticket prices, a single passenger class, and limited services.

nodes.name: Regional Airline
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide airline service for small cities. Regional carriers are also used to support larger full-service carriers.

nodes.name: Express Courier Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide express delivery courier services by ground or air transportation, and typically within one to three days.

nodes.name: Ground Courier Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide delivery courier services by ground transport

nodes.name: Mail Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide postal services, including the pickup and delivery of mail and the operation of national post offices.

nodes.name: Coastal Freight Shipping
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that transport freight overseas, tow barges, and rent vessels for freight transport.

nodes.name: Container Shipping
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide marine transportation of freight by container ship. These ships transport standardized containers holding a wide range of consumer and industrial products.

nodes.name: Dry Bulk Shipping
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide marine transportation of dry bulk commodity products. Typically, the ships used are bulk carriers that are designed to transport large amounts of dry, unpackaged cargo.

nodes.name: Inland Water Shipping
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that transport freight on rivers, canals, and lakes on vessels not suitable for ocean transport.

nodes.name: Roll-On Roll-Off Shipping
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide marine transportation of automobiles and other vehicles. Ships are referred to as RO-ROs (roll-on/roll-off).

nodes.name: Tanker Shipping
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide marine transportation of liquids or gases in bulk.

nodes.name: Intermodal Freight - Rail
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that transport products by rail using intermodal containers and trailers.

nodes.name: Total Commodity - Rail
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that transport commodities by rail. Includes agricultural and fertilizer products, automotive products, chemical products, coal and coke, consumer products, forest products, industrial products, metallic ores and metal products, and non-metallic minerals.

nodes.name: Asset-Based LTL
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide less-than-truckload (LTL) trucking services. LTL carriers typically pick up multiple shipments from multiple customers on a single truck and then route that freight for delivery through service centers where the freight may be transferred to other trucks with similar destinations.

nodes.name: Asset-Based Truckload
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide truckload trucking services, including delivery of products from only one shipper to the consignee.

nodes.name: Moving Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide moving services, such as moving household and office furniture and equipment.

nodes.name: Specialized Freight Trucking Svcs
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide specialized freight trucking services, such as transporting bulk commodities and automobiles, as well as dedicated trucking services.

nodes.name: Passenger Rail
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide railway-based passenger transportation services.

nodes.name: Bus Transportation
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide bus passenger transit services. Such services can operate within metropolitan and suburban areas or between cities and urban areas.

nodes.name: Taxi Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide taxi services via automobile or van.

nodes.name: Ferry Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that transport passengers on ferries and other inland waters vessels that are not suited for ocean transport.

nodes.name: Helicopter Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide helicopter passenger services, such as commuter helicopter service. Excludes transportation of oil workers to oil platforms (see Oil & Gas Services).

nodes.name: Logistics Brokerage
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide transportation brokerage services, such as air freight, intermodal, ocean, and other brokerage services.

nodes.name: Freight Forwarding Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide freight forwarding services. These companies do not move the products themselves, but arrange the shipment by contracting with carriers.

nodes.name: Intermodal Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide intermodal services. These services involve transporting freight through intermodal containers with the use of various forms of transportation. The company may transport the goods themselves or contract with carriers.

nodes.name: Storage & Warehousing Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide storage and warehousing services.

nodes.name: Transportation Infra Operators
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that operate infrastructure used for truck, rail, air, and marine transportation.
nodes.nameZh: 交通运输基础设施运营商

nodes.name: Transport Support Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide services to assist in the day-to-day functions of transportation service providers.

nodes.name: Architectural Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide architectural design services for residential, commercial, and industrial buildings.

nodes.name: Construction Engineering Svcs
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide civil engineering services for infrastructure or buildings.

nodes.name: Ind & Traffic Engineering Svcs
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide industrial engineering services by designing systems aimed to make human processes more efficient., such as traffic management systems.

nodes.name: Environmental Engineering Svcs
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide environmental engineering and consulting services.

nodes.name: Communication Infra Const
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that build infrastructure used by the communications industry.

nodes.name: Energy Infra Construction
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that build power plants, as well as oil and gas pipelines.

nodes.name: Transportation Infra Const
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that build transportation infrastructure, such as highways, railways, and ports.
nodes.nameZh: 交通运输基础设施建设

nodes.name: Utility Line Construction
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that build utility network infrastructure.

nodes.name: Commercial Building Const
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that construct commercial buildings, such as malls and shopping centers.

nodes.name: Residential Building Const
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that construct multi-story condominiums or apartment buildings.

nodes.name: Industrial Buildings Const
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that construct industrial buildings, such as warehouses and industrial parks.

nodes.name: Institutional Buildings Const
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that construct institutional buildings, such as government and religious buildings.

nodes.name: Crop Chemicals
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture chemicals that kill or deter various pests or threats to crops.

nodes.name: Fertilizers
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture chemicals that supply nutrients to plants.

nodes.name: Seeds & Agriculture Biotech
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that research and develop patented seed and agricultural products. Revenue is primarily realized through patents and may include integrated manufacturing or licensing of patents. Includes genetic engineering of seeds and crops.

nodes.name: Inorganic Base Chemicals
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture non-carbon-based chemicals in high volumes.

nodes.name: Organic Chem & Intermediates
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture carbon-based chemicals in high volumes. Most of these chemicals are derived from organic sources such as petroleum (petrochemicals).

nodes.name: Organic Resins, Fibers & Rubber
nodes.nameLong: Organic Resins, Fibers, Rubber & Derivatives Manufacturing
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture fibers and chemicals used in various forms of plastics or rubbers.

nodes.name: Adhesives & Sealants
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture chemicals with the purpose of binding or sealing. Includes adhesives, glues and caulks.

nodes.name: Advanced Materials
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture advanced materials, materials that are engineered for novel properties and superior performance.

nodes.name: Catalysts
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture inorganic or organic catalysts commonly used for refinery processes, automotive emissions control, and other feedstock and chemicals processing.

nodes.name: Consumer Retail Chemicals
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture chemicals for retail consumer applications not elsewhere classified.

nodes.name: Electronic Chemicals
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture specialty chemicals primarily used by the electronics industry. These chemicals are often used in the production of integrated circuits, displays, and other electronic components. Excludes chemicals used as a feedstock for semiconductors (see Assembly Materials & Solutions).

nodes.name: Explosives
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture explosives. Includes gunpowder, TNT, and dynamite.

nodes.name: Fine Chemicals
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture complex, low-volume, high-purity chemicals. Fine chemicals are expensive and often manufactured under contract, most commonly for pharmaceutical companies.

nodes.name: Flavors & Fragrances
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that specialize in manufacturing chemicals for flavors and fragrances. These chemicals are used in retail consumer goods or foods.

nodes.name: Functional Additives
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture specialty chemicals that contribute to the functional characteristics of finished goods. Excludes chemicals that contribute to smell or taste of finished goods (see Flavors & Fragrances).

nodes.name: Ind & Instl Cleaning Chemicals
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture chemicals and services used in large-scale sanitation, cleaning, and public health applications, such as restaurants, hotels or hospitals.
nodes.nameZh: 工业与机构清洁化学品

nodes.name: Oilfield Chemicals
nodes.definition: This segment includes chemicals used in oil and natural gas exploration and production, including drilling fluids, fracking aids, antifouling agents, and transport additives.

nodes.name: Paints & Coatings
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture paints and/or mix pigments, solvents, and binders into paints and other coatings.

nodes.name: Printing Ink
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture printing inks and inkjet cartridges.

nodes.name: Synthetic Dye & Pigments
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that chemically manufacture dyes and pigments.

nodes.name: Water Treatment Chemicals
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture chemicals used to treat/disinfect water. Typically, these are used in public utility water treatment or industrial processes. Includes chlorine, chloramine, and chlorine dioxide.

nodes.name: Chem & Allied Prods Whslrs
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that wholesale and distribute basic and diversified chemicals and/or specialty chemicals.

nodes.name: Plastic Matl & Forms Whslrs
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that wholesale and distribute intermediate plastic products and/or chemicals used in plastics manufacturing. Includes wholesale distribution of plastics, organic resins, plastic film, plastic sheeting, and plastic foams.
nodes.nameZh: 塑料材料与型材批发商

nodes.name: Aggregates
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that mine and quarry stones. Typically, these aggregates are uniform in size and have other industrial uses beyond construction.

nodes.name: Asphalt
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture asphalt. Asphalt is a byproduct of crude oil production. It is used for road construction, when heated and mixed with aggregates. Also known as bitumen.

nodes.name: Cement
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture cement. Cement is a powdery binder that is added to aggregates to create concrete.

nodes.name: Ready Mix Concrete
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture concrete. Concrete is a composite material composed of cement, aggregates and water. These companies manufacture concrete at a batching plant and deliver their products to construction sites in concrete mixers. Also known as ready mixed concrete or ReMiCon.

nodes.name: Brick, Tile & Clay Bldg Matl
nodes.nameLong: Brick, Tile & Clay Building Materials Manufacturing
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture building products, including bricks, clay tiles, ceramic wall and floor tiles, and non-clay refractory products.

nodes.name: Concrete Products
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture concrete construction materials and products.

nodes.name: Building Glass
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture glass used in construction applications.

nodes.name: Gypsum Products
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture construction materials made with gypsum. Includes wallboard, drywall, and plasterboard.

nodes.name: Insulation Products
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture construction insulation products.

nodes.name: Plastic Building Materials
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture construction materials primarily derived from plastic.

nodes.name: Roofing Materials
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture roofing materials, components of roofing systems and roofing accessories. Includes asphalt shingles and roofing cement.

nodes.name: Sundry Building Products
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture abrasive products and nonmetallic mineral products.

nodes.name: Stone Building Products
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that mine stone or manufacture stone building products.

nodes.name: Glass Containers
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture glass containers used in packaging applications. Includes glass bottles, glass jars, and other types of glass containers.

nodes.name: Metal Containers & Packaging
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture metal containers and metal materials used in packaging applications. Includes metal cans, metal lids, and aluminum foil.

nodes.name: Paper Containers & Packaging
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture paper containers and paper-based packaging materials.

nodes.name: Plastic Containers & Packaging
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture plastic containers and films used in packaging applications.

nodes.name: Packaging Labels
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture packaging labels and tapes. These can be made of paper, plastic, or aluminum with a pressure-sensitive adhesive backing.

nodes.name: Timber Resources
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that operate and manage forestry lands or timber tracts. These companies own the underlying forest land rights to grow and maintain the timber resources.

nodes.name: Logging
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that conduct logging operations, including cutting timber, log harvesting, and wood chipping.

nodes.name: Nursery & Tree Products
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that specialize in operating nurseries and growing trees and plants for non-retail consumers. Includes flower nurseries, Christmas tree farms, and rose nurseries. Excludes nurseries for retail consumers (Nursery & Garden Centers).

nodes.name: Rubber Plantation
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that grow rubber trees in natural or planted forests.

nodes.name: Paper
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture a diverse offering of paper and paper products from pulp.

nodes.name: Pulp
nodes.definition: This segment includes mills that produce pulp from plant materials. Includes wood, hemp, cotton, and other plant materials used in paper production.

nodes.name: Structural Wood
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture wood products used for structural or load bearing purposes. Structural wood is graded for physical properties and strength. Includes trusses, beams, and joists.

nodes.name: Non-Structural Wood
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture wood products that are used for non-structural or decorative purposes.

nodes.name: Flat Rolled
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that produce steel processed on rolls with flat faces to create flat/sheet steel products. Includes hot-rolled, cold-rolled, and galvanized sheets, strip and tin.

nodes.name: Long, Pipe & Tubular
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that produce steel pipes, wire, rods, and structural products.

nodes.name: Specialty Metals
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture flat-rolled and long products made of stainless steel, titanium, and high alloy steels.

nodes.name: Metal Service Centers
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that operate metal service center locations that distribute metal products to industrial customers. These service centers also provide value-added services including cutting, tempering, cold rolling, heat treating, and painting.

nodes.name: Steel Processors
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide processing services for metal products. Excludes companies that wholesale and distribute from a storefront location (see Service Center).

nodes.name: Iron Ore Mining
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that mine iron ore as a raw material for steel making. Also includes companies exploring for new iron ore mining locations.

nodes.name: Iron Foundries
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that operate foundries to produce iron castings.

nodes.name: Aluminum
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that mine bauxite, produce alumina, smelt primary aluminum, and process secondary aluminum (recycling scrap to form new aluminum products).

nodes.name: Cobalt
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that mine and refine cobalt.

nodes.name: Copper
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that mine and refine copper ore.

nodes.name: Manganese
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that mine and refine manganese.

nodes.name: Molybdenum
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that mine and refine molybdenum.

nodes.name: Nickel, Lead & Zinc
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that mine nickel, lead, and zinc ore and their related aggregates.

nodes.name: Tin
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that mine and refine tin.

nodes.name: Uranium
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that mine uranium ore or extract uranium from the ore for further refinement or enrichment.

nodes.name: Gold
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that mine gold.

nodes.name: Platinum Group
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that mine platinum, palladium, iridium, rhodium, osmium, and ruthenium.

nodes.name: Silver
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that mine silver.

nodes.name: Mineral Mining
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that mine minerals not elsewhere classified.

nodes.name: Precious Stone Mining
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that mine precious stones.

nodes.name: Thermal Coal
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that mine coal used for energy production. Also known as thermal coal or steam coal.

nodes.name: Metallurgical Coal
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that mine coal used for steel production. Also known as coking coal.

nodes.name: Coal Support Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide support services for coal mining operations.

nodes.name: Metals Support Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide support services for metal mining operations.

nodes.name: Non-Metallic Mining Support
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide support services for non-metallic mining operations.

nodes.name: Broadcasting Equipment
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture television and radio broadcasting equipment used to create, manage and transmit media content.

nodes.name: Data Networking Equipment
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture data networking equipment for wireless and wireline networks. Includes enterprise networking equipment, as well as small business and home premises equipment.

nodes.name: Mobile Phones
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture mobile telephones.

nodes.name: Telecommunications Equipment
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture telecommunications equipment. Includes infrastructure and customer premises equipment for wireline and wireless networks.

nodes.name: Audio Equipment
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture audio equipment.

nodes.name: Camera Equipment
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture cameras and camera equipment.

nodes.name: Displays
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design or manufacture display hardware. Excludes unfinished products used as components for other types of electronics (see Display Components).

nodes.name: GPS Devices
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture portable global positioning system (GPS) devices used in consumer applications, such as in cars or for hiking and traveling.

nodes.name: Keyboards & Mice
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design or manufacture keyboards, mice, and other input/output computer devices.

nodes.name: Office Electronics
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design or manufacture electronic hardware used for office-related purposes. Includes printers, scanners, photocopiers, and supplies for these electronics.

nodes.name: Video Equipment
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture consumer video equipment such as video playback and recording devices.

nodes.name: Video Game Equipment
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture video game equipment, such as consoles and accessories.

nodes.name: Personal Computers
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design or manufacture personal computers. Includes desktop computers, notebooks, workstations, and handheld devices.

nodes.name: Computer Storage
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design or manufacture computer storage devices. Includes hard drives, server-based storage, and flash drives.

nodes.name: Servers
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design or manufacture computer servers.

nodes.name: Supercomputers
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture high-performance and super computers.

nodes.name: 3D Printers
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design or manufacture 3D printers.

nodes.name: Biometric & ID Systems
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture biometric and other identification systems.

nodes.name: Optical Instruments & Lens
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture lenses (except ophthalmic lenses) and optical instruments. Includes telescopes, binoculars, microscopes, gun sights, prisms, night vision equipment, thermal imaging equipment, and crystals.

nodes.name: Surveil & Traffic Mgmt Systems
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design or manufacture surveillance or traffic management systems.

nodes.name: Transaction Mgmt Systems
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design or manufacture transaction management systems. Includes ATMs, self-service kiosks, point-of-sale terminals, and credit card readers.

nodes.name: Communication Equip Cmpnts
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design or manufacture communications equipment components.

nodes.name: Display Components
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design or manufacture components for display purposes. These components can be utilized in various types of end products, such as cellphones, tablets and checkout machines.

nodes.name: Electronics Batteries
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture finished batteries or battery cells utilized for technology hardware products.

nodes.name: Passive Components
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design or manufacture passive components for use in technology hardware products. Includes resistors, capacitors, inductors, and transformers.

nodes.name: PCBs
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design or manufacture printed circuit boards (PCB) for use in technology hardware products.

nodes.name: EMS
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide electronics manufacturing services (EMS). Such companies provide technology product manufacturing and assembly services on a contract basis.

nodes.name: ODM
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide original design manufacturing (ODM) services. Unlike pure contract manufacturers, ODM firms also design products that they may sell under their own brand name in addition to what is marketed under the original equipment manufacturer (OEM).

nodes.name: Back End Capital Equipment
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture back-end semiconductor capital equipment used in the assembly and testing phase of semiconductor fabrication. Includes automated test equipment, wire bonders, die bonders, and encapsulation products.

nodes.name: Front End Capital Equipment
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture front-end semiconductor capital equipment or manufacture machinery used to make silicon wafers. Includes deposition equipment (ALD, CVD, PVD), etching equipment, cleaning systems, thermal processing equipment, chemical mechanical planarization equipment, ion implantation equipment, and photolithography equipment.

nodes.name: Assembly Material & Solutions
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture assembly materials and solutions used in semiconductor integrated circuit (IC) manufacturing.

nodes.name: Assembly & Testing Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide outsourced assembly (or packaging) and testing services for designers of semiconductor integrated circuits (ICs).

nodes.name: Foundry Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide outsourced manufacturing for designers of semiconductor integrated circuits (ICs).

nodes.name: Silicon Products
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture silicon products that are used as raw materials in semiconductor integrated circuit (IC) manufacturing.

nodes.name: Analog ICs
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design or manufacture semiconductor devices or integrated circuits (ICs) for analog or mixed-signal circuitry.

nodes.name: Discrete
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design or manufacture discrete semiconductor devices or discrete circuits.

nodes.name: Intellectual Property - Semi
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that create, license, and market semiconductor intellectual property.

nodes.name: Memory ICs
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design or manufacture memory semiconductor devices or integrated circuits (ICs). Memory ICs are further divided into volatile and non-volatile types.

nodes.name: Logic, Processors & App Specific
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design or manufacture logic integrated circuits (ICs), processors, and application-specific ICs.
nodes.nameZh: 逻辑、处理器及特定应用

nodes.name: Analytics & Visualization
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that develop software designed to analyze and display data, such as big data analysis and reporting software.

nodes.name: Content & Collaboration Software
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that develop software that creates, maintains, publishes, or shares content such as documents and digital media. Includes document readers, printing software, graphic design software, media players, 3D modelling, and other media software.

nodes.name: Engineering Software
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that develop software for the scientific, engineering, construction, and manufacturing markets. Includes CAD (computer-aided design) software, digital prototyping software, product life cycle management software, and other software designed to improve manufacturing processes.

nodes.name: Enterprise Software
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that develop software used to support the internal operations of organizations and improve productivity and efficiency. Includes software developed for internal accounting, customer relationship management (CRM), data processing, enterprise resource management (ERM), human capital management (HCM), supply chain management (SCM), office tools, and related enterprise-wide solutions.

nodes.name: Specialty Software
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that develop software to cater to specific applications or niche functions not elsewhere classifiable. Typically, these applications are unique to a single industry.

nodes.name: Cloud & Virtualization Software
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that develop and operate cloud and virtualization services.

nodes.name: Database Software
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that develop software used to manage the creation, storage, maintenance, or querying of databases.

nodes.name: Security Software
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that develop computer security and recovery software for consumer applications. Includes anti-virus software, system resource recovery software, and system backup.

nodes.name: System Software
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that develop software that is designed to interface with hardware and provide a platform for application software to operate.

nodes.name: IT Services - Commercial
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that perform specialized IT functions for commercial companies. Includes IT outsourcing, technology consulting, and business process outsourcing (BPO).

nodes.name: IT Services - Government
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide IT services to government agencies across a broad range of topics and activities ranging from administrative support and business process outsourcing (BPO) to military project implementation.

nodes.name: Fossil Electric Generation
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that generate electricity from centralized power plants from fossil electric fuel resources.

nodes.name: Nuclear Power Generation
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that generate electricity using heat supplied by nuclear reactors.

nodes.name: Renewable Energy Generation
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that operate under regulated revenue arrangements to generate electricity from renewable resources.

nodes.name: Power Storage
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that store energy via large industrial battery systems, compressed air systems, gravitational potential energy systems, thermal storage systems, or other emergent technologies which store and release energy when needed.

nodes.name: Electric Transmission
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that own and operate mid- and high-voltage regulated electricity networks that span wide areas.

nodes.name: Electric Distribution
