nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that own and operate low-voltage regulated electricity networks that span local areas.

nodes.name: Gas Transmission & Storage
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that operate natural gas transmission and storage networks that operate at high pressure or are national networks. It includes both regulated and merchant revenue streams and also transmission of other related gases for energy purposes.

nodes.name: Gas Distribution
nodes.definition: This segment includes natural gas distribution networks that operate at low pressure or are local area networks. Revenues are normally regulated by an independent (elected) or politically appointed regulatory body. Includes methane and propane.

nodes.name: Water Sewage Networks
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that own and/or operate networks focusing on the post-consumption components of the water cycle.

nodes.name: Water Supply Networks
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that own or operate networks focusing on the pre-consumption components of the water cycle.

nodes.name: Electricity Marketing & Trading
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that sell and trade electricity to end users.

nodes.name: Gas Marketing & Trading
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that sell and trade natural gas to end users.

nodes.name: Advertising Agencies
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that create advertising campaigns for use in newspapers, magazines, radio, television or other media.

nodes.name: E-Marketing
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that specialize in creating advertising campaigns via Internet media. Includes email marketing, mobile and website advertising, search engine optimization, and social media marketing.

nodes.name: Market Research & Consulting
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide market research, opinion polling or marketing consulting services.

nodes.name: Media Representatives
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that sell media time or space on behalf of media owners.

nodes.name: Public Relations Agencies
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide public relations services. Public relations services manage the communication and spread of information between their clients and the public.

nodes.name: Advertising Material Distr Svcs
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that direct distribute advertising materials or samples.

nodes.name: Direct Mail Advertising
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that create advertisements and campaigns that are distributed through mail services. Includes mail advertisements, fliers, pamphlets, and coupons.

nodes.name: Film & TV Production
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that produce film, videos, television programs, or television commercials.

nodes.name: Film & Video Distribution
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that acquire film and video distribution rights and distribute film, videotapes, DVDs and other formats to movie theaters, television networks and TV stations.

nodes.name: Teleprod & Postprod Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide postproduction services for film and TV. Includes editing film, titling, subtitling, credits, and closed captioning.

nodes.name: Online Film & TV Streaming
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that create, acquire distribution rights, and distribute film and television shows directly to consumers online via websites or mobile applications. Excludes companies that do not produce content.

nodes.name: Cable Networks
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that aggregate, market, and distribute television programs to cable companies, satellite companies, and wireline telecommunications companies. These networks negotiate with local and international distributors to broadcast programming on a subscription or fee basis.

nodes.name: TV Broadcast Networks
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that aggregate, market, and distribute television programs to affiliate TV broadcasting stations. These stations then transmit the programming to viewers over public airways.

nodes.name: Professional Book Publishers
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that publish books used by specific professions.

nodes.name: School Textbook Publishers

nodes.name: Radio Stations

nodes.name: Ridesharing Svcs
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that offer ridesharing or other services for the transportation of individuals online or via applications. These companies do not own the mode of transportation.

nodes.name: Mobile Phone Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes wireless carriers that offer mobile voice services.

nodes.name: Mobile Data Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes wireless carriers that provide a broad range of mobile data services, such as wireless Internet access, video, games, ring tones, and music.

nodes.name: Mobile Text Messaging (SMS)
nodes.definition: This segment includes wireless carriers that offer mobile short message service (SMS), also known as text messaging.

nodes.name: Mobile Roaming Services
