nodes.name: Residential Property Mgmt
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide management services for residential property.

nodes.name: Senior Housing Operators
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manage and operate senior housing facilities. These companies provide outsourced management services on behalf of the property owners.

nodes.name: Real Estate Brokerage - Lease
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide brokerage services for real estate leasing between a lessee and the property owner for a fee.

nodes.name: Real Estate Brokerage - Sales
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide brokerage services for real estate sales between a buyer and a seller for a fee.

nodes.name: Continuing Care
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that operate a type of a retirement community where the needs of aging care, from independent living to skilled nursing, are met in one place. Excludes in-home elderly care services (see Home Health Care Services).

nodes.name: LTAC & Skilled Nursing
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide skilled nursing and long-term care services to patients. This is a place of residence for people who require constant nursing care and have significant challenges with activities of daily living.

nodes.name: Kidney Dialysis Centers
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide outpatient kidney or renal dialysis services.

nodes.name: Outpatient Care Centers
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide general or specialized outpatient care services, such as pain therapy centers, sleep disorder centers, and biofeedback centers.

nodes.name: Rehabilitation Centers
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide specialty mental and physical rehabilitation services.

nodes.name: Surgical & Emergency Centers
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide emergency care and surgery services on an outpatient basis.

nodes.name: Clinical Labs
nodes.definition: This segment includes medical laboratories that provide analytical or diagnostic services to a medical professional or to the patient on referral from a health care practitioner.

nodes.name: Radiology & Diagnostic Imaging
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide diagnostic imaging services that produce images of a patient on referral from a health care practitioner. Includes CAT scans, x-rays, mammograms, magnetic resonance imaging (MRIs), and ultrasound images.

nodes.name: Ambulance Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide patient transportation services by ground or air with medical care.

nodes.name: Home Health Care Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide skilled nursing services in the home. Includes visiting nurse and home nursing services.

nodes.name: Medical Equip Distribution
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that wholesale and distribute professional medical equipment, instruments, and supplies. Includes surgical appliances, hospital beds, dentist equipment, laboratory equipment, hospital furniture, and wheelchairs.

nodes.name: Medical Supplies Distribution
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that wholesale and distribute medical supplies to health care providers.

nodes.name: Pharma & Specialty Distribution
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that wholesale and distribute pharmaceutical drugs, biological and medical products, herbs, and botanical drugs.

nodes.name: Managed Care Medicaid (XIX)
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide managed health care services through a health maintenance organization (HMO) structure to participants in the Medicaid program.

nodes.name: Managed Care Medicare
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide managed health care services through a health maintenance organization (HMO) structure to participants in all Medicare programs.

nodes.name: Electrophysiology Devices
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture electrophysiology devices, including heart pumps, blood pumps, replacement hearts, and catheters used to treat atrial fibrillation. Includes pacemakers, implantable cardioverter-defibrillators (ICDs), ventricle assist devices (VADs), defibrillators, ablation catheters, and any other cardiovascular device that uses an electrical impulse that is not a heart monitor.

nodes.name: Interventional Cardiology
nodes.definition: This segment includes devices used in interventional cardiology procedures to repair heart damage and in peripheral vascular procedures to treat vascular and endovascular diseases. Includes coronary stents (drug-eluting and bare-metal), heart valves, coronary stent grafts, cardiac surgery devices, vascular closure devices, vascular plugs, IVUS catheters, atherectomy devices, and peripheral vascular and neurovascular stents and coils.

nodes.name: Reconstructive Implants
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture reconstructive implants and all other orthopedic devices unrelated to spinal disorders. Includes prosthetic joints (hips, knees and shoulders), bone cement, and dental devices.

nodes.name: Spinal Devices
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture devices and their related biologics to treat spine-related disorders, such as back pain, degenerative disc disease, arthritis, spinal stenosis, and lumbar disc herniation.

nodes.name: Imaging Equipment
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture equipment used in diagnostic imaging. Includes x-ray, computed tomography imaging, ultrasound, tomography, and magnetic resonance imaging equipment.

nodes.name: Radiation Therapy
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture equipment used to deliver a dose of radiation to control malignant cells as part of cancer treatment.

nodes.name: Aircraft Engines & Eng Parts
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture aircraft engines and aircraft engine parts or provide major engine overhauls and rebuilding.
nodes.nameZh: 飞机发动机及发动机零部件

nodes.name: Aircraft Structure & Equipment
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture aircraft parts, such as wings, fuselage, airframes, tail assemblies, and sub-assemblies.

nodes.name: Aircraft Electronics
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture aerospace and defense electronics, radar systems, guidance systems, and navigation systems.

nodes.name: A/C Heating & Fridge Equip
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture air conditioning and warm air furnace equipment, as well as commercial and industrial walk-in refrigeration and freezer equipment.

nodes.name: Water Heating Equipment
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture water heaters and boilers.

nodes.name: Industrial Fans & Blowers
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture attic fans, blowers, and industrial and commercial fans, such as exhaust and ventilating fans.

nodes.name: Commercial Light Fixtures
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture electric lamp bulbs, lighting fixtures, and parts for commercial markets.

nodes.name: Residential Light Fixtures
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture electric lamp bulbs, lighting fixtures, and parts for residential markets.

nodes.name: Fire Detection Devices
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture fire detection systems, such as smoke detectors.

nodes.name: Security Systems
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture security systems designed to detect intruders or burglars. Such systems include motion detectors, or devices that recognize and respond to the opening of a door or window. They also include after-market car alarm systems.

nodes.name: Electric Power Generators
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture electricity generators that utilize fossil fuels for power. Excludes electricity generators made for exclusive use with renewable energy sources. Includes stationary and portable generators.

nodes.name: Nuclear Power Gen Equip & Sys
nodes.nameLong: Nuclear Power Generation Equipment & Systems Manufacturing
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that produce nuclear power generation equipment and systems.

nodes.name: Power Boiler & Heat Exchangers
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture equipment used for the production and/or dissemination of steam for the purpose of building heating or electricity generation. Excludes companies that make steam generators (see Turbine Generators).

nodes.name: Turbine Generators
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture turbines and turbine generator sets. Includes steam turbines and gas turbines. Excludes turbines used in renewable energy applications.

nodes.name: Power Gen Equip Parts & Svcs
nodes.nameLong: Power Generation Equipment Parts & Services Manufacturing
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide parts and aftermarket services for power generation equipment. Includes maintenance services and manufacturing of spare parts and aftermarket consumables.
nodes.nameZh: 发电设备零部件与服务

nodes.name: Power Automation Equipment
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture power automation equipment or systems utilized in power generation facilities or their networks.

nodes.name: Switchgear, Transformer & Other
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture electrical equipment primarily used within utility transmission and distribution networks such as transformers, and switchgear apparatus.
nodes.nameZh: 开关设备、变压器及其他

nodes.name: Electric Power Grid Parts & Svcs
nodes.nameLong: Electric Power Grid Parts Manufacturing & Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide parts and aftermarket services for power transmission, distribution and automation equipment. Includes maintenance services and manufacturing of spare parts and aftermarket consumables.

nodes.name: Farm Tractors & Field Machinery
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture utility tractors, small and large row crop tractors, self-propelled combines, and hay equipment.
nodes.nameZh: 农用拖拉机与田间作业机械

nodes.name: Implement & Irrigation Equip
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture accessories attached to tractors to perform duties such as tilling, planting, clearing, etc. Such accessories can be pulled or pushed depending on application and type.

nodes.name: Mining Material Handling Equip
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture material handling equipment for the mining, aggregates, and construction industries.

nodes.name: Surface Mining Machinery
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture surface mining machinery. Such machinery includes electric mining shovels, blasthole drills, draglines, and mining trucks.

nodes.name: Underground Mining Machinery
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture underground mining machinery. Such machinery includes draglines, longwall shearers, stage loaders, roof supports, face conveyors, continuous haulage systems, batch haulage vehicles, shovels and excavators, and mining trucks.

nodes.name: Automatic Vending Machinery
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture automated vending machines or coin-operated mechanisms for machines.

nodes.name: Commercial Laundry Machinery
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture commercial laundry and dry-cleaning equipment and pressing machines. Exclude laundry machines for home use (see Household Appliance).

nodes.name: Hand Tools
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture non-powered hand and edge tools. Includes hammers, screwdrivers, axes, garden tools, pliers, and ratchets.

nodes.name: Power Tools
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture power-driven hand tools. Includes circular saws, chain saws, nail guns, planers, paint spray guns, riveting guns, routers, drills, and sanders.

nodes.name: Tool Accessories
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture accessories or consumable supplies used for tools. Includes saw blades, sanding belts, tool attachments, tool storage equipment, and tool mounts.

nodes.name: Ind Process Furnace & Oven
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture industrial-process furnaces and ovens. Includes metal melting furnaces, garbage incinerators, paint baking and drying ovens, tile and ceramic kilns, and distillation ovens.

nodes.name: Motor & Generator
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture general purpose industrial motors and generators. Typically, these are semi-finished products that will be used as components for various industrial machinery products. Excludes finished generator equipment (see Power Generation Equipment) and hydraulic equipment (see Fluid Power Pump & Motor).

nodes.name: Scale & Balance
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture commercial scales and balances. Includes industrial scales, motor truck scales, post office-type scales, and retail scales.

nodes.name: Commercial Veh Mfg - Electric
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture electric, on-highway commercial vehicles, such as medium and heavy trucks.

nodes.name: Commercial Veh Mfg - Fossil Fuels
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture fossil fuel, on-highway commercial vehicles, such as medium and heavy trucks.
nodes.nameZh: 商用车辆制造-化石燃料

nodes.name: Diesel Locomotives
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture diesel locomotives for the transport of both freight and passengers.

nodes.name: Electric Locomotives
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture electric locomotives for the transport of both freight and passengers.

nodes.name: Rail Freight Cars
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture commercial freight railroad rolling stock.

nodes.name: Rail Passenger Cars
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture passenger railroad cars for both suburban and intercity transport.

nodes.name: Ball & Roller Bearing
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture rolling-element bearings designed to reduce rotational friction.

nodes.name: Bolts & Washers
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture fastening hardware, such as bolts, nuts, screws, rivets, and washers.

nodes.name: Fabricated Pipe & Pipe Fitting
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture pipes and various fittings for pipes and tubes made of metals other than iron or steel.

nodes.name: Metal Valve
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture metal valves used to regulate the passage of fluids.

nodes.name: Forging & Stamping
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that shape or reinforce metal by applying heat, pressure, and mechanical force.

nodes.name: Industrial Pattern
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture foundry cores and patterns used to mold various shapes in either iron or steel mills.

nodes.name: Industrial Tanks & Storage
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture metal tanks, vessels, and other containers.

nodes.name: Machine Shops
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide a diverse offering of metalworking processes for custom manufacturing services.

nodes.name: Metal Coat & Treating
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that coat and treat metal, typically as a finishing process.

nodes.name: Sheet Metal
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture prefabricated metal buildings, panels, sections, and sheet metal.

nodes.name: Structural Metal & Plate Work
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture products made of large metal plates.

nodes.name: Wire Products
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture springs and wires. Typically, these products are made by passing drawn metal through progressively smaller dies or holes in draw plates.

nodes.name: Mechanical Rubber Products
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture rubber goods for mechanical applications. Includes O-rings, gaskets, seals, and rubber bushings.

nodes.name: Non-Mechanical Rubber Products
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture rubber goods for non-mechanical applications.

nodes.name: Const/Mining Mach/Equip Whslrs
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that wholesale and distribute specialized machinery, equipment, and parts used in construction, mining, and logging activities.
nodes.nameZh: 建筑/采矿机械/设备批发商

nodes.name: Farm/Garden Mach/Equip Whslrs
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that wholesale and distribute specialized machinery, equipment and parts used in farming activities. Includes tractors, harvesters, and irrigation equipment.
nodes.nameZh: 农业/园艺机械/设备批发商

nodes.name: Industrial Mach & Equip Whslrs
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that wholesale and distribute stationary machinery and equipment.
nodes.nameZh: 工业机械与设备批发商

nodes.name: Transport Equip & Sply Whslrs
nodes.nameLong: Transportation Equipment & Supplies (excluding Motor Vehicle) Wholesalers
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that wholesale and distribute on-highway commercial vehicles and parts.
nodes.nameZh: 交通运输设备与物资批发商

nodes.name: HVAC Equip & Supplies Whslrs
nodes.nameLong: Heating, Ventilation & A/C Equipment & Supplies Wholesalers
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that wholesale and distribute heating, ventilation, and air conditioning products.
nodes.nameZh: 暖通空调设备与用品批发商

nodes.name: Electrical Supplies Whslrs
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that wholesale and distribute electrical supplies for commercial use.

nodes.name: Janitorial Supplies Whslrs
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that wholesale and distribute janitorial and sanitary supplies for commercial use.

nodes.name: Plumbing Supplies Whslrs
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that wholesale and distribute plumbing supplies for commercial use.

nodes.name: Commercial Vehicle Rental Svcs
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that rent on-highway commercial vehicles, such as tractor-trailers, busses, motor coaches, and commercial vans. Excludes light trucks (see Light Trucks).

nodes.name: General Equip Rental Svcs
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that rent generic equipment with broad applications across industries. Includes ladders, fencing, tools, and portable toilets.

nodes.name: Industrial Equip Rent Svcs
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that rent or lease electrical equipment or other industrial products not elsewhere classified. Includes HVAC equipment and power generators.

nodes.name: Machinery Rental Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that rent or lease heavy machinery, such as those used in mining, construction, and material handling.

nodes.name: Hazardous Waste Collection
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide hazardous waste collection services. Includes the collection and hauling of radioactive waste, medical waste, and oil and other hydrocarbons.

nodes.name: Hazardous Waste Treat & Disp
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide hazardous waste treatment and disposal services.

nodes.name: Bio-Waste Collection & Treatment
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies involved in the production of gas, digestate, or chemicals by collecting or treating bio-waste through anaerobic digestion.
nodes.nameZh: 生物质废物收集与处理

nodes.name: Landfill Gas Capture
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that produce gas through the capture of gas from landfills.

nodes.name: Recycling Facilities
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that operate facilities that recycle and/or recover materials. Includes collecting, sorting and/or separating recyclable materials, such as plastics, rubber, glass, and metals.

nodes.name: Remediation Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide remediation services. Such services include asbestos abatement, lead paint removal, oil spill cleanup, soil remediation and mine reclamation services.

nodes.name: Solid Waste Collection
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide solid waste collection services. Includes pickup and hauling of garbage or recyclable materials from the point of collection to landfills, transfer facilities, or recycling facilities.

nodes.name: Solid Waste Incinerators
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that operate solid waste combustors and incinerators.

nodes.name: Solid Waste Landfill
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that operate solid waste landfill facilities for the disposal of solid waste.

nodes.name: Solid Waste Transfer
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that operate solid waste transfer facilities. Such facilities consolidate and compact the solid waste and then transport it to disposal sites by rail or truck.

nodes.name: Law Firms
nodes.definition: This segment includes offices of legal practitioners. Includes attorneys' offices, barristers' offices, criminal law offices, law firms, and solicitors' offices.

nodes.name: Patent, Notary & Paralegal Svcs
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide notary services, public services, paralegal services, patent agent services, and process-serving services.
nodes.nameZh: 专利、公证及法律助理服务

nodes.name: Lobbying Firms
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that advocate for the passage or defeat of legislation, regulations, government appointees, and budget allocations on the international, national, regional, state, and municipal levels. This includes organizations describing themselves as government affairs and government consulting firms.

nodes.name: Employment Agencies
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that serve as intermediaries between companies looking to hire and potential job candidates.

nodes.name: Executive Search
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide executive search, recruitment and/or placement services for clients with specific executive or senior management needs.

nodes.name: General Management Consulting
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide operating advice and assistance to businesses and other organizations on administrative management issues, such as financial planning and budgeting, records management, office planning, strategic and organizational planning, site selection, new business startup, and business process improvement.

nodes.name: Talent Management Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide promotional agency services. These companies enter into contractual agreements with their clients and aid in the career development of their clients, most often through the procurement of job placements. Typically, these companies specialize in specific fields such as modelling, music and sports, and are also known as talent agencies.

nodes.name: Temporary Help
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide workers to clients' businesses for limited periods of time to supplement the client's existing work force.

nodes.name: Accounting Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that audit the accounting records of public and private organizations.

nodes.name: Tax Preparation Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide tax return, payroll, and bookkeeping services.

nodes.name: Charter Airline - Full Svc
nodes.definition: This segment includes full-service carrier revenue generated from chartered airline operations. Charter flights are usually nonscheduled and carry mainly tourists or military personnel as passengers.

nodes.name: Mainline Airline - Full Svc
nodes.definition: This segment includes full-service carrier revenue generated from mainline passenger air operations. Services are conducted with long-haul aircrafts to domestic and international destinations.

nodes.name: Regional Airline - Full Svc
nodes.definition: This segment includes full-service carrier revenue generated from regional operations, such as contract carriers and/or regional subsidiaries.

nodes.name: Other Airline Rev - Full Svc
nodes.definition: This segment includes full-service carrier revenue generated from ancillary passenger activities and/or onboard product sales, such as booking fees, baggage fees, frequent flyer programs, and leasing income as well as the sale of onboard food, goods, telecommunications services, and gaming proceeds.
nodes.nameZh: 其他客运收入-全方位服务

nodes.name: Chartered Airline - LCC
nodes.definition: This segment includes low-cost carrier revenue generated from charted airline operations.

nodes.name: Mainline Airline - LCC
nodes.definition: This segment includes low-cost carrier revenue generated from mainline airline operations.

nodes.name: Regional Airline - LCC
nodes.definition: This segment includes low-cost carrier revenue generated from regional operations, such as contract carriers and/or regional subsidiaries.

nodes.name: Other Airline Rev - LCC
nodes.definition: This segment includes low-cost carrier revenue generated from ancillary passenger activities and/or onboard product sales, such as booking fees, baggage fees, frequent flyer programs, and leasing income as well as the sale of onboard food, goods, telecommunications services, and gaming proceeds.

nodes.name: Chartered Airline - Regional
nodes.definition: This segment includes regional carrier revenue generated from airline charter operations.

nodes.name: Mainline Airline - Regional
nodes.definition: This segment includes regional carrier revenue generated from mainline airline operations.

nodes.name: Regional Airline - Regional
nodes.definition: This segment includes regional carrier revenue generated from regional operations, such as contract carriers and/or regional subsidiaries.

nodes.name: Other Airline Rev - Regional
nodes.definition: This segment includes regional carrier revenue generated from ancillary passenger activities and/or onboard product sales, such as booking fees, baggage fees, frequent flyer programs, and leasing income as well as the sale of onboard food, goods, telecommunications services and gaming proceeds.

nodes.name: Chemical Tanker Shipping
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide marine transportation of chemicals using chemical tanker carriers.

nodes.name: LPG & LNG Tanker Shipping
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide marine transportation of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) and liquefied natural gas (LNG) via LPG/LNG carriers.

nodes.name: Oil Tanker Shipping
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide marine transportation of oil and refined petroleum products via oil and product tankers.

nodes.name: Agriculture Freight - Rail
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that transport agricultural products by rail. Includes corn, wheat, soybeans, and food and beverage products.

nodes.name: Auto Freight - Rail
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that transport automotive products by rail. Includes finished vehicles and automotive parts.

nodes.name: Chemical Freight - Rail
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that transport chemical products by rail.

nodes.name: Coal Freight - Rail
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that transport coal and coke by rail.

nodes.name: Consumer Prods Freight - Rail
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that transport consumer products by rail.

nodes.name: Forest Products Freight - Rail
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that transport forest and paper products by rail.

nodes.name: Industrial Prods Freight - Rail
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that transport industrial products by rail.

nodes.name: Metallic Ores & Metals - Rail
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that transport metal products by rail. Includes steel, copper, minerals, and other metal products.

nodes.name: Non-Metal Minerals - Rail
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that transport non-metallic minerals and products by rail. Includes crushed stone, sand, gravel, clay, glass, cement, and limestone.

nodes.name: Less Than Truckload Freight
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that generate freight revenue from less-than-truckload trucking services.

nodes.name: LTL Fuel Surcharge
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that generate fuel surcharge revenue from less-than-truckload (LTL) trucking services.

nodes.name: Truckload Freight
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that generate revenue from truckload trucking services.

nodes.name: Truckload Fuel
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that generate fuel surcharge revenue from truckload trucking services.

nodes.name: Intercity Passenger Rail
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide long distance passenger rail services.

nodes.name: Commuter Rail
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide local and suburban commuter passenger rail services, within a metropolitan area and adjacent suburban areas. Includes local rail services, subways, trolley, and trams.

nodes.name: Interurban & Rural Bus Transp
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide bus passenger services outside a single metropolitan area. Such services are provided between cities or in rural areas.

nodes.name: Local Bus Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide local and suburban bus passenger services within metropolitan areas and adjacent suburban areas.

nodes.name: Taxi Services - Electric
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide taxi services via electric vehicles

nodes.name: Taxi Services - Fossil Fuels
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide taxi services via fossil fuel vehicles

nodes.name: Ferry Services - Electric
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide ferry services via electric vessels.

nodes.name: Ferry Services - Fossil Fuels
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide ferry services via fossil fuel vessels.

nodes.name: Air Freight Brokerage
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide air freight brokerage services.

nodes.name: Intermodal Brokerage
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide intermodal brokerage services.

nodes.name: Ocean Brokerage
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide ocean brokerage services.

nodes.name: Truck Brokerage
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide truckload and less-than-truckload brokerage services.

nodes.name: Airport Operators
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that operate airports. Includes the maintenance of airport facilities and runways, baggage handling services, cargo handling, and hangar rental.

nodes.name: Port & Harbor Operators
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that operate ports and harbors. Includes port facility operation, marine cargo handling, harbor and lighthouse operation, and canal operation.

nodes.name: Hway/Brdg/Tunnel Operators
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that operate toll highways, bridges and tunnels. Includes toll collection and maintenance support of roadways and related structures.
nodes.nameZh: 高速公路/桥梁/隧道运营商

nodes.name: Air Transp Support Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide air transportation support services, including airport operations and aircraft maintenance and fueling.

nodes.name: Marine Support Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide marine support services. Includes operation of port facilities, cargo handling, dry-dock services, and navigational services.

nodes.name: Rail Support Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide railroad support activities. Includes rail terminal operation, loading and unloading services, and locomotive and rail car repair.

nodes.name: Trucking Support Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide trucking support services, such as equipment maintenance, rentals, and tank washing.

nodes.name: Cable Line Construction
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that lay cable and build utility lines used in the telecommunications and utility industries.

nodes.name: Comm & Transmission Const
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that build communications and transmission infrastructure, such as cellular phone towers, satellite receiving stations and radio signal transmission towers. Also includes companies that own, operate and rent equipment space on cellular phone towers.

nodes.name: Network Construction
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that offer specialty network design and construction services to wireless and wireline telecom carriers.

nodes.name: Power Plant Construction
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that construct electricity generation facilities that do not use renewable energy sources or nuclear energy for power (see Development & Construction or Nuclear Power Construction).

nodes.name: Nuclear Power Construction
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that build nuclear power generation facilities.

nodes.name: Oil & Gas Infra Construction
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that build oil and gas sector infrastructure, such as refineries, pumping stations, and petrochemical plants.
nodes.nameZh: 石油与天然气基础设施建设

nodes.name: Airport & Highway Const
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that build highway and airport infrastructure, including highways, streets, bridges and tunnels, airports, and runways.

nodes.name: Maritime Construction
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that build maritime infrastructure, such as port facilities and canals.

nodes.name: Railway & Subway Construction
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that build train and subway infrastructure, including railway lines, railway roadbeds, subways, and tunnels.

nodes.name: Electric Utility Line Const
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that construct the distribution lines for electricity as well as the structures integral for long-distance power lines.

nodes.name: Gas Utility Line Construction
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that build natural gas transmission and distribution infrastructure. Such activities do not include the manufacture of equipment or the continued operation of infrastructure subsequent to its construction.

nodes.name: Water Utility Line Construction
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that build water treatment and distribution infrastructure. Such activities do not include the manufacture of equipment or the continued operation of infrastructure subsequent to its construction.

nodes.name: Fungicides
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture chemicals that kill or inhibit growth of fungi or fungal spores.

nodes.name: Herbicides
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture chemicals that kill or inhibit growth of unwanted plants.

nodes.name: Insecticides
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture chemicals that kill or deter insects.

nodes.name: Fertilizer Blending & Distr
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that blend and source fertilizer materials from suppliers. Excludes companies that manufacture the underlying fertilizer materials.

nodes.name: Nitrogenous Fertilizers
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture fertilizers used as a source of nitrogen nutrition for plants. Includes ammonia fertilizers, nitrate fertilizers, and amide fertilizers.

nodes.name: Phosphate Fertilizers
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture fertilizers based on rock phosphate. Includes monoammonium phosphate (MAP), diammonium phosphate (DAP), and ammonium polyphosphate (APP).

nodes.name: Potassium Fertilizers
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture fertilizers based on potassium. Includes potassium chloride, potassium sulphate, and monopotassium phosphate.

nodes.name: Alkalis & Chlorine
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture chemicals derived from chloralkali chemical processes. Includes alkalis, chlorine, and caustic soda.

nodes.name: Bulk Acids
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture inorganic acids. Includes mineral acid, hydrochloric acid, nitric acid, phosphoric acid, sulfuric acid, boric acid, hydrofluoric acid, and perchloric acid.

nodes.name: Industrial Gas
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture industrial organic and inorganic gases in liquid, solid and compressed forms. These gases include basic elemental gases as well as compound gases. Includes carbon dioxide, dry ice, helium, neon, nitrogen and oxygen.

nodes.name: Alcohols
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture industrial alcohols. Includes methanol, petroleum ethanol, and butanol.

nodes.name: Aromatics
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture aromatic compounds. Includes benzene, toluene, and xylene.

nodes.name: Intermediates
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture intermediates. Intermediates are a type of petrochemical produced from stream cracker plants. These are chemicals typically derived from aromatics and olefins. Includes toluene, diisocyanate, vinyl acetate, styrene, ethylene, dichloride, and propylene oxide.

nodes.name: Olefins
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture olefins. Olefins are a type of petrochemical. Includes ethylene, propylene and butadiene.

nodes.name: Other Organic Base Chemicals
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture organic chemicals not classified elsewhere.
nodes.nameZh: 其他有机化学基础材料

nodes.name: Artificial Fibers & Filaments
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture standardized fibers. Typically, these fibers are used for further processing in textiles or composites.

nodes.name: Organic Resins
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture organic resins. These resins are most commonly used in the production of plastics. Includes allyl, amino, cellulose, cresol, polystyrene, polyethylene and polypropylene.

nodes.name: Synthetic Rubber
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture synthetic rubber. Includes elastomers, polyethylene rubber, urethane rubber, N-type rubber, S-type rubber and vulcanized oils.

nodes.name: Advanced Ceramics
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture ceramic products that are designed to be highly impact or heat resistant. Includes ceramic armor and insulation.

nodes.name: Carbon Fiber
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture carbon fiber. Carbon fiber is a specific type of composite composed of polymer resins and carbon fibers.

nodes.name: Composites
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture materials based on blended components not classified elsewhere.

nodes.name: Engineering Plastics
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture plastic materials with greater mechanical or thermal properties than commodity plastics. These materials are often used to replace metals, due to their lighter weight.

nodes.name: Graphite Products
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture graphite products. Includes electrodes and pencil graphite.

nodes.name: Nanotechnology
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture extremely small materials sometimes used to improve the characteristics of another material. Includes nanomaterials. Excludes nanotechnology used for medical purposes.

nodes.name: Special Coated Metals
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture metals that have been bonded or coated to deter abrasion or corrosion, or to improve heat resistance.

nodes.name: Cosmetic Additives
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture functional additives used in cosmetics.

nodes.name: Fluid & Lubricant Additives
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture finished lubricant products or functional additives that contribute to the viscosity or fluidity of finished goods. Primarily, these are additives for industrial purposes, such as engine and machine lubrication, hydraulics and heat transfer.

nodes.name: Food Additives
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture functional additives that are primarily used for food processing and functional quality enhancement. Excludes manufacturers that produce consumer facing food additives (see Food Ingredients).

nodes.name: Paper Additives & Process Chem
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture functional additives that are primarily utilized in paper production processes. Excludes chemicals that contribute to the smell or taste of finished goods (see Flavors & Fragrances).
nodes.nameZh: 造纸助剂及工艺处理化学品

nodes.name: Polymer Additives
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture functional additives that alter/improve the physical properties or performance of a polymer. Includes antioxidants and flame retardants.

nodes.name: Industrial Coatings
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture paints and coatings with diversified industrial applications, including automotive, aerospace, marine, industrial and packaging.

nodes.name: Specialty Coatings
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture coating products that improve the appearance of and provide protection to a given material.

nodes.name: Inorganic Dye & Pigments
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture non-carbon-based dyes and pigments. Includes color pigments, umber, and zinc-based pigments.

nodes.name: Organic Dye & Pigments
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture carbon-based dyes and pigments that do not naturally occur in nature. Includes lakes and toners.

nodes.name: Crushed Stone
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that mine rock deposits and break the rock into the desired size using crushers.

nodes.name: Sand & Gravel
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that extract, mine, and/or quarry sand and gravel.

nodes.name: Brick & Structural Clay Tile
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture clay bricks and clay tiles. Excludes bricks made from concrete (see Concrete Block & Brick Manufacturing).

nodes.name: Non-Clay Refract
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture non-clay refractory (high temperature) products.

nodes.name: Concrete Block & Brick
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture concrete blocks and bricks. Excludes bricks made from clay (see Brick & Structural Clay Tile Manufacturing).

nodes.name: Concrete Pipe
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture concrete pipes used for sewers and irrigation.

nodes.name: Mineral Wool
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture insulation from mineral fibers, such as fiberglass and stone wool.

nodes.name: Polystyrene Foam Insulation
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture polystyrene foam insulation. Excludes companies that manufacture bulk foam used in various end products (see Polystyrene Foam Product).
nodes.nameZh: 聚苯乙烯泡沫绝缘产品

nodes.name: Abrasive Products
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture sandpaper, grinding wheels, and other abrasive products.

nodes.name: Nonmetal Mineral Products
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture nonmetallic mineral products used in construction not elsewhere classified.

nodes.name: Limestone
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that mine or manufacture building products from limestone or related stone. Includes broken limestone, dolomite, cement rock, marl and chalk.

nodes.name: Dimension Stone
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that mine and quarry stones that are shaped to specific sizes and dimensions. Excludes small fabricated stones for use in road manufacturing (see Aggregates).

nodes.name: Granite
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that mine or manufacture building products from granite and related stone. Includes broken granite, gneiss, riprap, syenite, and diorite.

nodes.name: Aluminum Foil for Packaging
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture aluminum foil used in flexible packaging applications.

nodes.name: Metal Containers
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture metal containers used in packaging applications. Includes soda cans, soup cans, paint cans, and metal lids.

nodes.name: Corrugated Packaging Matl
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture cardboard items used in packaging applications. Includes corrugated boxes, linerboard boxes, and cardboard boxes.

nodes.name: Molded Fiber Packaging Prods
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture molded, paper-based containers. These products are made from paper pulp that is formed by a molding process. Includes egg cartons, food trays, and coffee filters.

nodes.name: Paper Bag
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture paper bags used in packaging applications. Includes paper grocery bags, paper multiwall bags, and paper sacks.

nodes.name: Paper Food Containers
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture sanitary containers used when serving food. Includes milk cartons, paper plates, paper cups, paper bowls, paper takeout boxes, and paper soup cups. Excludes containers used for other packaging applications.

nodes.name: Paperboard Packaging Materials
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture paperboard and paperboard boxes used in packaging applications. Includes carton board boxes, carton board containers, and paperboard sheets.

nodes.name: Plastic Bag & Pouch
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture plastic bags. Includes storage bags, grocery bags, merchandise bags, plastic multiwall bags, garbage bags, and t-shirt bags.

nodes.name: Plastic Bottle
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture plastic bottles and their closures. Includes PET bottles, plastic bottles, and plastic caps.

nodes.name: Plastic Packaging Film & Sheet
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture flexible plastic sheets and films used in packaging applications. Includes industrial plastic wrap and packaging shrink wrap.

nodes.name: Protective Packaging Materials
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture packaging materials used to protect other products during shipment. Includes bubble wrap, fabricated foam, and molding foam.

nodes.name: Sawmills
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that operate sawmills.

nodes.name: Softwood Veneer & Plywood
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture softwood veneer, softwood plywood, and softwood flooring. Includes cedar plywood, pine plywood, and spruce plywood.

nodes.name: Engineered Wood
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture fabricated or laminated wood composites used for structural purposes. Excludes engineered wood in truss or panel form.

nodes.name: Wood Preservation
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that treat wood products with preservatives to prevent decay. Excludes manufacturing of wood products.

nodes.name: Hardwood Veneer & Plywood
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture hardwood veneer and hardwood plywood. Includes ash plywood, birch plywood, balsa plywood, and oak plywood.

nodes.name: Reconstituted Wood Products
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture reconstituted wood sheets and boards.

nodes.name: Long Products
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that produce long products. Includes bars, rods, rebar, channels, and structural products (I-beams, girders).

nodes.name: Pipe & Tubular
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that produce steel tubes and pipes.

nodes.name: Steel Wire Drawing
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture steel wire.

nodes.name: Bauxite Mining
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that mine bauxite and refine it into alumina.

nodes.name: Aluminum Smelting & Refining
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that produce aluminum from alumina.

nodes.name: Copper Mining
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that mine copper ore.

nodes.name: Copper Smelting & Refining
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that smelt and refine copper.

nodes.name: Lead
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that mine lead ore.

nodes.name: Nickel
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that mine nickel ore.

nodes.name: Zinc
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that mine zinc ore.

nodes.name: Palladium
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that mine palladium.

nodes.name: Platinum
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that mine platinum.

nodes.name: Rhodium
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that mine rhodium.

nodes.name: Clay
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that mine and quarry clays and ceramics.

nodes.name: Lithium
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that mine and refine lithium.

nodes.name: Phosphate Rock
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that mine rock phosphate.

nodes.name: Potash, Soda, Borate
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that mine and refine potash, soda, and borate.

nodes.name: Rare Earth
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that mine and refine rare earth metals.

nodes.name: Diamonds
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that mine and quarry diamonds.

nodes.name: Gemstones
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that mine and quarry gemstones such as jade, amethyst, zircon, emerald, and garnet.

nodes.name: Bitum Coal & Lignite Surface
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that mine surface bituminous and lignite coal.

nodes.name: Bituminous Coal Underground
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that mine underground bituminous coal.

nodes.name: Home & Sm Business Netw Equip
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture and market home and small business networking equipment, such as routers, modems, and adapters. Includes both wireless and wireline home networking products.
nodes.nameZh: 家庭与小企业网络设备

nodes.name: Wireless Data Network Equip
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture data networking equipment used to manage and transmit mobile data.

nodes.name: Wireline Data Network Equip
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture enterprise and carrier-class networking equipment, such as routers, switches, bridges, and gateways.

nodes.name: Wireless Telecom Equipment
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture wireless and satellite communications equipment, such as wireless networking, satellite communications, and mobile radio communications equipment.

nodes.name: Wireline Telecom Equipment
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture wired communications and networking equipment. Such equipment is used by wireline telecom service providers and cable television operators. Communications devices like phone systems and video conferencing equipment are also included.

nodes.name: Home & Car Audio Equipment
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture home and car stereo systems and equipment. Includes home sound systems, speakers, satellite radio, AM/FM radio, receivers, subwoofers, and car audio dashboard units.

nodes.name: Personal Audio Devices
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture personal, portable audio devices. Includes MP3 players, portable CD players, and portable satellite radio devices.

nodes.name: Professional Audio Equipment
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture professional audio equipment used to record and process sound in professional forums. Typically, this equipment is used for television/radio broadcasting, film production, and live music entertainment events. Includes turntables, mixers, professional microphones, recorders, signal processors, and boom poles.

nodes.name: Digital Cameras
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture both digital and film cameras that are primarily used for taking still photographs.

nodes.name: Video Cameras
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture both digital and film cameras that are primarily used for recording video.

nodes.name: Camera Accessories
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture camera accessories and supplies, such as interchangeable lenses, flash devices, cables, and photographic film.

nodes.name: TV & Monitors
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design or manufacture televisions and monitors. Televisions have a built-in tuner and are utilized for home entertainment purposes. Monitors do not have a TV tuner and are primarily utilized for computers.

nodes.name: Specialty Displays
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture displays not elsewhere classified. Includes projectors, LED billboard displays, and other electronic advertising displays.

nodes.name: Printers, Copiers & Scanners
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design or manufacture printers, scanners and photocopying systems.
nodes.nameZh: 打印机、复印机和扫描仪

nodes.name: Office Electronics Supplies
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design or manufacture printing and imaging supplies, as well as other equipment not elsewhere classified.

nodes.name: Desktop Computers
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design or manufacture desktop computers.

nodes.name: Handheld Computers
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design or manufacture handheld computers. Includes tablet computers, nano personal computers, and other handheld computing devices.

nodes.name: Notebook Computers
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design or manufacture computer notebooks, also known as laptops.

nodes.name: Workstations
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design or manufacture workstations. Workstations are commercial computers that typically offer greater performance than traditional personal computers and are often specialized to operate specific resource-demanding application software.

nodes.name: Hard Disk Drives
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design or manufacture computer hard drives and portable hard drives.

nodes.name: Solid State Drives
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design or manufacture solid-state disk drives (SSDs). Excludes companies that design or manufacture the underlying memory IC chips (see Memory ICs).

nodes.name: Network Storage & Fabric
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design or manufacture network or server-based storage devices.

nodes.name: Hard Drive Components
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design or manufacture internal components specifically for use in computer hard drives. Includes spindle heads, magnetic readers, and disk balancing mechanisms. Excludes companies that design or manufacture the underlying memory IC chips (see Memory ICs).

nodes.name: ATM
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design or manufacture automated teller machines (ATMs).

nodes.name: POS Terminals
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture point-of-sale (POS) terminals. Includes electronic cash registers, self-checkout kiosks, and credit card readers.

nodes.name: Display Panels
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture display panels. These display panels are the primary modules that produce the images in the display.

nodes.name: Touch Solution
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture components utilized to detect touch for touchscreen displays.

nodes.name: Electronic Glass
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture specialized glass involved in the production of a display.

nodes.name: App Specific Analog
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design or manufacture analog semiconductor devices or integrated circuits (ICs) for application-specific standard products (products specific to certain industries).

nodes.name: Power Management
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design or manufacture analog semiconductor devices or integrated circuits (ICs) for power management products.

nodes.name: Standard Linear - General
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design or manufacture generic analog semiconductor devices or integrated circuits (ICs) that are used in multiple products in multiple industries.

nodes.name: Discretes, Sensors & Actuators
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design or manufacture sensors, actuators, or other discrete semiconductor devices.
nodes.nameZh: 分立器件、传感器及执行器

nodes.name: LED
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design or manufacture discrete semiconductor devices or discrete circuits for light emitting diodes (LEDs).

nodes.name: Optical Components
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design or manufacture discrete semiconductor devices or discrete circuits focused on optical components.

nodes.name: NAND Flash
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design or manufacture NAND flash memory semiconductor devices or integrated circuits (ICs).

nodes.name: NOR Flash
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design or manufacture NOR flash memory semiconductor devices or integrated circuits (ICs).

nodes.name: DRAM
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design or manufacture dynamic random access memory (DRAM) semiconductor devices or integrated circuits (ICs). DRAM is a type of volatile memory used extensively in computer hardware.

nodes.name: SRAM
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design or manufacture static random access memory (SRAM) semiconductor devices or integrated circuits (ICs). SRAMs are commonly used in electronic switches.

nodes.name: App Specific Communication
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design or manufacture analog or digital semiconductor devices or integrated circuits (ICs) for communications products.

nodes.name: App Specific I/O & Storage
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design or manufacture analog or digital computing and consumer semiconductor devices or integrated circuits (ICs) for personal computer logic products.
nodes.nameZh: 特定应用输入输出与存储

nodes.name: App Specific Multimedia
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design or manufacture analog or digital computing and consumer semiconductor devices or integrated circuits (ICs) focused on multimedia functions. Includes semiconductor devices, such as graphics ICs and audio codecs.

nodes.name: Logic
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design and manufacture programmable logic semiconductor devices (PLDs). Includes field programmable gate arrays (FPGAs) and complex programmable logic devices (CPLDs).

nodes.name: Microcontrollers
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design or manufacture analog or digital computing and consumer semiconductor devices or integrated circuits (ICs) for microcontroller products.

nodes.name: Microprocessors
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design or manufacture analog or digital computing and consumer semiconductor devices or integrated circuits (ICs) for microprocessor products.

nodes.name: Communications Software
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that develop software for communication purposes. Includes telecommunications, wireless and other networking software.

nodes.name: Education Software
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that develop software for educational purposes.

nodes.name: Gambling Software
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that develop software for gambling machines and games, sports betting, and other software that supports gambling operations.

nodes.name: Health Care Software
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that develop software for use in the health care sector.

nodes.name: Business Process Outsourcing
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide outsourced services related to operational business aspects and processes of the client company. Includes HR administration, accounting, customer service, sourcing & procurement, supply chain management, or any other back office operation excluding technology implementation/management (see IT Outsourcing).

nodes.name: IT Outsourcing
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide outsourced software development, IT administration and operations, network management, technology hardware maintenance, and recovery activities.

nodes.name: Network Integration Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design networks and/or install, manage and maintain network elements, such as transmission, switching, and access systems.

nodes.name: Technology Consulting
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide IT design and strategy, IT operations assessment, and IT maintenance planning.

nodes.name: Fossil Electric - Regulated
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that operate under regulated revenue arrangements to generate electricity from fossil fuels.

nodes.name: Fossil Electric - Deregulated
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that operate under deregulated revenue arrangements to generate electricity from fossil fuels.

nodes.name: Nuclear Power - Regulated
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that operate under regulated revenue arrangements to generate electricity from nuclear energy.

nodes.name: Nuclear Power - Deregulated
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that operate under deregulated revenue arrangements to generate electricity from nuclear energy.

nodes.name: Solar Energy Generation
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that generate electricity from solar energy resources.

nodes.name: Wind Energy Generation
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that generate electricity from wind resources.

nodes.name: Geothermal Energy Generation
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that generate electricity where the heat source to drive steam generators comes from geothermal resources.

nodes.name: Hydropower Generation
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that generate energy from falling or running water.

nodes.name: Marine Energy Generation
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that generate energy from the kinetic motions of waves and tides. Energy can also be generated from temperature and salinity differences.

nodes.name: Biomass & Waste Energy Gen
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that generate electricity from biomass or industrial/residential waste resources.
nodes.nameZh: 生物质能与废弃物能源发电

nodes.name: Thermal Energy Storage
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that operates facilities that store thermal energy and return it at a later time in the form of thermal energy or other energy vectors.

nodes.name: Natural Gas Transmission
nodes.definition: This segment includes operation and maintenance of natural gas transmission networks. Includes both merchant and regulated revenue arrangements.

nodes.name: Natural Gas Storage
nodes.definition: This segment includes natural gas storage facilities connected to transmission networks, such as storage facilities in saline caverns or depleted oil fields. Includes both merchant and regulated revenue arrangements.

nodes.name: Hydrogen Transmission & Storage
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that operate hydrogen transmission and storage networks used for power generation, fuel-cell recharging, or other energy related purposes.

nodes.name: CO2 Transmission & Storage
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that operate carbon dioxide (CO₂) pipelines and storage, the main purpose of which is the isolation of CO₂ from the atmosphere.

nodes.name: Propane Gas Distributors
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that retail propane or liquid petroleum gas (LPG) through distribution networks that distribute gas in portable tanks and/or via tanker trucks. These enterprises operate in competitive, unregulated markets.

nodes.name: Natural Gas Distributors
nodes.definition: This segment includes natural gas distribution networks that operate at low pressure / local area networks sending out methane. Revenues are normally regulated by an independent (elected) or politically appointed regulatory body.

nodes.name: Marketing Consulting Services
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide marketing consulting services.

nodes.name: Market Research
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide market research and opinion polling.

nodes.name: Film Production
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that produce films.

nodes.name: TV & Video Production
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that produce television programs and other videos.

nodes.name: Film Distribution
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that acquire film distribution rights and distribute videotapes, DVDs and other formats to movie theaters, television networks and TV stations.

nodes.name: TV Show Syndication
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that acquire TV show distribution rights and distribute to television networks and stations.

nodes.name: Adv Rev - Cable Networks
nodes.definition: This segment includes revenue that cable networks generate from advertising.

nodes.name: Other Rev - Cable Networks
nodes.definition: This segment includes revenue that cable networks generate from sources other than advertising.

nodes.name: Adv Rev - TV Broadcast Netw
nodes.definition: This segment includes revenue that TV broadcast networks generates from advertising.
nodes.nameZh: 广告收入-电视广播网络

nodes.name: Other Rev - TV Broadcast Netw
nodes.definition: This segment includes revenue that TV broadcast networks generate from sources other than advertising.
nodes.nameZh: 其他收入-电视广播网络

nodes.name: Display Advertising
nodes.definition: This segment includes revenue generated by the display of graphical advertisements on a webpage.

nodes.name: Search Advertising
nodes.definition: This segment includes revenue generated from text-based links to an advertiser's website from Web searches conducted on an Internet search engine.

nodes.name: Men's Footwear
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design men's non-athletic footwear.

nodes.name: Women's Footwear
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that design women's non-athletic footwear.

nodes.name: Fabric Coating Mills
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide fabric coating, such as coating fabrics in wax to improve strength.

nodes.name: Nonwoven Textile & Fabric Finish
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide finishing touches to non-fabric textile products.
nodes.nameZh: 无纺布织物与面料加工

nodes.name: Woven Fabric Finishing Mills
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that finish woven fabrics by providing basic stitching and other finishing touches.

nodes.name: Nonwoven Fabric Mill
nodes.definition: This segment includes mills that manufacture nonwoven fabric material. Nonwoven fabric is created by thermal, mechanical or chemical bonding rather than weaving or knitting.

nodes.name: Woven Fabric Mills
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that take fiber, yarn, and thread and weave them into fabrics used to make garments.

nodes.name: Synthetic Fiber & Thread
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture synthetic fibers and threads, such as polyester, nylon, and acrylics.

nodes.name: Thread Mills
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that produce threads, a thin type of yarn used to stitch fabrics.

nodes.name: Yarn Spinning Mills
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that spin yarn from fiber materials, such as cotton.

nodes.name: Yarn Texturizing, Throw & Twist
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that texturize yarn, which is a process in which multiple filament yarns are combined to create a strong, spun yarn.

nodes.name: Upholstered Wood Furniture
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture upholstered wood household furniture.

nodes.name: Nonupholstered Wood Furniture
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that manufacture non-upholstered wood household furniture.

nodes.name: Fast Casual Rest - Franchise
nodes.definition: This segment includes revenue that fast casual restaurants generate from their franchising operations such as revenue from licensing, royalties, or providing supplies and equipment to franchisees.

nodes.name: Fast Casual Rest - Owned
nodes.definition: This segment includes revenue that fast casual restaurants generate from the operations of their company-owned restaurants.

nodes.name: Fast Food Rest - Franchise
nodes.definition: This segment includes revenue that fast food restaurants generate from their franchising operations such as revenue from licensing, royalty, or providing supplies and equipment to franchisee owners.

nodes.name: Fast Food Rest - Owned
nodes.definition: This segment includes revenue that fast food restaurants generate from the operations of their company-owned restaurants.

nodes.name: Coffee & Snack - Franchise
nodes.definition: This segment includes revenue that coffee and snack restaurants generate from their franchising operations, such as revenue from licensing, royalties, or providing supplies and equipment to franchisees.

nodes.name: Coffee & Snack - Owned
nodes.definition: This segment includes revenue that coffee and snack restaurants generate from the operations of their company-owned restaurants.

nodes.name: Casual Rest - Franchise
nodes.definition: This segment includes revenue that casual restaurants generate from their franchising operations, such as revenue from licensing, royalties, or providing supplies and equipment to franchisees.

nodes.name: Casual Rest - Owned
nodes.definition: This segment includes revenue that casual restaurants generate from the operations of their company-owned restaurants.

nodes.name: Upscale Rest - Franchise
nodes.definition: This segment includes revenue that upscale restaurants generate from their franchising operations, such as revenue from licensing, royalties, or providing supplies and equipment to franchisees.

nodes.name: Upscale Rest - Owned
nodes.definition: This segment includes revenue that upscale restaurants generate from the operations of their company-owned restaurants.

nodes.name: Independent Artists
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide performing arts production, such as choreography, cinematography, acting, and directing.

nodes.name: Event Promoters w/ Facilities
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that produce and promote performing arts events for their own venues.

nodes.name: Event Promoters w/o Facilities
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that produce and promote performing arts events, but do not own venues.

nodes.name: Theaters & Dinner Theaters
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that provide venues for live theatrical performances.

nodes.name: Passenger Veh Leasing - Electric
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that lease electric passenger vehicles.

nodes.name: Passenger Veh Leasing - Fossil Fuels
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that lease fossil fuel passenger vehicles.
nodes.nameZh: 乘用车辆租赁-化石燃料

nodes.name: Passenger Veh Rental - Electric
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that rent electric passenger vehicles.

nodes.name: Passenger Veh Rental - Fossil Fuels
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that rent fossil fuel passenger vehicles.
nodes.nameZh: 乘用车辆出租-化石燃料

nodes.name: Beef Cattle Ranch & Farming
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that raise cattle for beef.

nodes.name: Dairy Cattle & Milk Production
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that raise and breed dairy cattle and companies that produce raw milk.

nodes.name: Meat Processing
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that slaughter, dress, and process animals.

nodes.name: Poultry Processing
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that slaughter, dress and process poultry, such as chickens, turkeys, ducks, and geese.

nodes.name: Rendering & Meat Byproducts
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that render fats and oils from animals and plants. It includes companies that render grease and lard.

nodes.name: Finfish Farm & Fish Hatcheries
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that farm finfish.

nodes.name: Shellfish Farming
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that farm shellfish.

nodes.name: Finfish Fishing
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that catch finfish in their natural habitat.

nodes.name: Shellfish Fishing
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that catch shellfish in their natural habitat.

nodes.name: Apple Orchards
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that grow apples.

nodes.name: Citrus Groves (excl Oranges)
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that grow citrus fruits other than oranges.

nodes.name: Grape Vineyards
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that grow grapes.

nodes.name: Orange Groves
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that grow oranges.

nodes.name: Strawberry Farming
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that grow strawberries.

nodes.name: Corn Farming
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that grow corn.

nodes.name: Rice Farming
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that grow rice.

nodes.name: Wheat Farming
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that grow wheat.

nodes.name: Palm Oil Farming
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that grow palms for palm oil production.

nodes.name: Soybean Farming
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that grow soybeans or soybean by-products.

nodes.name: Fats & Oil Refining
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that refine cooking oils from purchased fats.

nodes.name: Flour Milling
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that mill grains into flour used in food products.

nodes.name: Malt

nodes.name: Palm Oil Processing
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that produce palm oil.

nodes.name: Rice Milling
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that process and mill raw rice.

nodes.name: Soybean Processing
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that process soybeans into tofu, oils, animal feed, and other edibles.

nodes.name: Wet Corn Milling
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that mill wet corn into corn flour.

nodes.name: Beet Sugar
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that produce beet sugar.

nodes.name: Cane Sugar Refining
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that produce sugar products from purchased raw cane sugar.

nodes.name: Sugarcane Mills
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that produce sugar manufactured by their own sugarcane mills, including brown sugar, white sugar, and molasses.

nodes.name: Cocoa Processing
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that process cocoa beans or seeds.

nodes.name: Coffee Processing
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that process coffee beans or seeds.

nodes.name: Fruit & Vegetable Canning
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that can fruit and vegetable products.

nodes.name: Specialty Canning
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that can complex food products such as soups and meal dishes.

nodes.name: Frozen Fruit & Vegetable
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that produce frozen fruits, vegetables, or concentrated juices.

nodes.name: Frozen Specialty Food
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that produce other frozen specialty foods, such as dinners, noodles, and microwave dishes.

nodes.name: Fresh & Frozen Seafood Process
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that prepare and package fresh and frozen seafood products.

nodes.name: Seafood Canning
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that can purchased seafood products but are not involved in fishing or fish farming.

nodes.name: Chocolate Confectionery
nodes.definition: This segment includes companies that produce confectionery products, such as candy and other desserts, that are primarily made of chocolate.

nodes.name: Sugar & Other Confectionery
